spec.title: Tokens over time (input vs output)
spec.description:
Goal: See how input vs output token volume is trending over the selected time range and filters.
Description: Sums agent_usage input_tokens (minus cache tokens unless include_cache_tokens is set) and output_tokens per time bucket across every currently selected dashboard filter, with no per-user/agent split.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(u.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens))) AS input,
  sum(u.output_tokens) AS output
FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_30'

spec.title: Tokens by agent/version over time

  FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
    AND (u.agent_name != '' OR u.skill_name = '')
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
    AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
    AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
    AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))

  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))

    AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))

spec.title: Cache hit rate by agent/skill/model over time
spec.description:
Goal: See whether prompt caching is actually landing for a given agent, skill, or model, and whether that's improving or regressing.
Description: cache_read_tokens / (cache_read_tokens + input_tokens) per time bucket, grouped by the same scope+model key as the token/cost panels.

spec.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
    concat(multiIf(agent_name != '', 'subagent', skill_name != '', 'skill', 'main agent'), ' - ', model) AS metric,
    sum(cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read,
    sum(input_tokens) AS input_tok
  FROM agent_usage
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
    AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
    AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
    AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_usage.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_usage.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_usage.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_usage.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
    AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
    AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], mcp_tool_name))
  GROUP BY time, metric
)
SELECT time, metric, cache_read / nullIf(cache_read + input_tok, 0) AS value
FROM filtered
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_22'

spec.title: Spend by user
spec.description:
Goal: Quickly identify which users are driving the most spend right now.
Description: Sums agent_usage.cost and tokens per user_id (resolved to a display name via ai_gateway_users_dict) over the selected range, ranked by cost descending.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  u.user_id,
  any(dictGetOrDefault('ai_gateway_users_dict', 'user_name', u.user_id, '')) AS user_name,
  sum(u.cost) AS cost,
  sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens)) + u.output_tokens) AS tokens
FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
GROUP BY u.user_id
ORDER BY cost DESC
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_10'

spec.title: Users breakdown
spec.description:
Goal: See token/cost/duration usage for every user, not just the top few.
Description: Joins per-user token/cost sums from agent_usage to a CTE summing agent_events session durations per user, sorted by tokens_total descending by default - the token counterpart to 'Spend by user'.

spec.rawSql:
WITH session_durations_period AS (
  SELECT session_id, user_id, dateDiff('second', min(timestamp), max(timestamp)) AS duration_s
  FROM agent_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  GROUP BY session_id, user_id
),
user_duration_period AS (
  SELECT user_id, sum(duration_s) AS duration_s FROM session_durations_period GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT
  u.user_id AS user_id,
  any(dictGetOrDefault('ai_gateway_users_dict', 'user_name', u.user_id, '')) AS user_name,
  sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens))) AS tokens_input,
  sum(u.output_tokens) AS tokens_output,
  sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens)) + u.output_tokens) AS tokens_total,
  sum(u.cost) AS cost,
  any(udp.duration_s) AS session_duration_s
FROM agent_usage u
LEFT JOIN user_duration_period udp ON udp.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
GROUP BY u.user_id
ORDER BY tokens_total DESC
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_20'

spec.title: Active users & sessions
spec.description:
Goal: Track whether the number of active people/sessions is growing or shrinking, smoothed to avoid day-to-day noise.
Description: Computes distinct daily users/sessions from agent_events bucketed by calendar day, then applies a 7-day rolling average window function over those daily buckets, independent of the Window variable used elsewhere.

spec.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS time,
    uniqExact(user_id) AS users_day,
    uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions_day
  FROM agent_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
  AND (NOT startsWith(tool_name, 'mcp__') OR (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], tool_name)))
  GROUP BY time
)
SELECT
  time,
  avg(sessions_day) OVER (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sessions,
  avg(users_day) OVER (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS users
FROM daily
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_29'

spec.title: Error rate by tool

spec.rawSql:
SELECT

  countIf(status = 'failure') AS failures,

  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))

  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (

GROUP BY tool_name
ORDER BY error_rate DESC
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_5'

spec.title: Latency percentiles (p50/p95) by tool_name
spec.description:
Goal: Flag which tools are slow, independent of the error-rate view.
Description: p50/p95 of agent_events.latency_ms (full call duration, endTime-startTime) grouped by tool_name; distinct from ttft_ms, which measures only time-to-first-token.

SELECT

spec.title: Top 10 most expensive sessions
spec.description:
Goal: Find outlier-cost sessions worth inspecting further in the Sessions & Debugging tab.
Description: Sums agent_usage cost/input-output tokens per session_id, left-joined to a per-session start-time/duration CTE derived from agent_events, ranked by cost descending and limited to 10.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  u.session_id AS session_id,
  u.user_id AS user_id,
  any(dictGetOrDefault('ai_gateway_users_dict', 'user_name', u.user_id, '')) AS user_name,
  any(ev.started_at) AS started_at,
  sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens))) AS tokens_input,
  sum(u.output_tokens) AS tokens_output,
  sum(u.cost) AS cost,
  any(ev.duration_s) AS duration_s,
  arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArray(u.model), ', ') AS models
FROM agent_usage u
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT session_id, min(timestamp) AS started_at, dateDiff('second', min(timestamp), max(timestamp)) AS duration_s
  FROM agent_events
  GROUP BY session_id
) ev ON u.session_id = ev.session_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
GROUP BY u.session_id, u.user_id
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 10
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_8'

spec.title: Agent version-change impact (before vs after adopting current version)
spec.description:
Goal: See whether adopting a new agent version measurably changed token/cost/error-rate compared to the version it replaced.
Description: Detects each agent's most recent version transition via lagInFrame over per-version first-seen timestamps, then averages usage/cost (agent_usage) and error rate (agent_events) before vs after that transition's start time.
Empty until an agent/skill actually has 2+ distinct versions observed in agent_usage - by design, this shows nothing for a brand-new agent/skill on its first version, not a query bug.

spec.rawSql:
WITH usage_f AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM agent_usage
  LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT session_id, argMax(git_branch, captured_at) AS git_branch, argMax(git_repo, captured_at) AS git_repo, argMax(issue_id, captured_at) AS issue_id
  FROM session_git_branch GROUP BY session_id
) gb ON gb.session_id = agent_usage.session_id
WHERE (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id)) AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR ('$provider' = 'claude' AND match(model, '^claude-')) OR ('$provider' = 'openai' AND match(model, '^(gpt-|chatgpt-|o[0-9]|text-embedding-|dall-e-|whisper|tts-)')) OR ('$provider' = 'other' AND NOT match(model, '^(claude-|gpt-|chatgpt-|o[0-9]|text-embedding-|dall-e-|whisper|tts-)')))
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_usage.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], coalesce(gb.git_branch, ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], coalesce(gb.git_repo, ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(gb.issue_id, ''), 'empty')))
    AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
    AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
    AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
    AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], mcp_tool_name))
),
events_f AS (
  SELECT * FROM agent_events
  LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT session_id, argMax(git_branch, captured_at) AS git_branch, argMax(git_repo, captured_at) AS git_repo, argMax(issue_id, captured_at) AS issue_id
  FROM session_git_branch GROUP BY session_id
) gb ON gb.session_id = agent_events.session_id
WHERE (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], coalesce(gb.git_branch, ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], coalesce(gb.git_repo, ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(gb.issue_id, ''), 'empty')))
    AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
    AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
    AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
    AND (NOT startsWith(tool_name, 'mcp__') OR (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], tool_name)))
),
version_starts AS (
  SELECT agent_name, agent_version, min(timestamp) AS started_at
  FROM usage_f
  WHERE agent_name != ''
  GROUP BY agent_name, agent_version
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT *,
    lagInFrame(agent_version) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_name ORDER BY started_at) AS prev_version,
    lagInFrame(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_name ORDER BY started_at) AS prev_started_at,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY agent_name ORDER BY started_at DESC) AS rn
  FROM version_starts
),
transitions AS (
  SELECT agent_name, agent_version AS current_version, started_at, prev_version, prev_started_at
  FROM ordered
  WHERE rn = 1 AND prev_version != ''
),
usage_after AS (
  SELECT t.agent_name, t.current_version, t.prev_version, t.started_at,
    avgIf((uf.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (uf.cache_creation_tokens + uf.cache_read_tokens)) + uf.output_tokens, uf.timestamp >= t.started_at) AS avg_tokens_after,
    avgIf(uf.cost, uf.timestamp >= t.started_at) AS avg_cost_after
  FROM transitions t
  LEFT JOIN usage_f uf ON uf.agent_name = t.agent_name AND uf.agent_version = t.current_version
  GROUP BY t.agent_name, t.current_version, t.prev_version, t.started_at
),
usage_before AS (
  SELECT t.agent_name, t.current_version,
    avgIf((uf.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (uf.cache_creation_tokens + uf.cache_read_tokens)) + uf.output_tokens, uf.timestamp < t.started_at AND uf.timestamp >= t.prev_started_at) AS avg_tokens_before,
    avgIf(uf.cost, uf.timestamp < t.started_at AND uf.timestamp >= t.prev_started_at) AS avg_cost_before
  FROM transitions t
  LEFT JOIN usage_f uf ON uf.agent_name = t.agent_name AND uf.agent_version = t.prev_version
  GROUP BY t.agent_name, t.current_version
),
events_after AS (
  SELECT t.agent_name, t.current_version,
    countIf(ev.event_type = 'PostToolUseFailure' AND ev.timestamp >= t.started_at) / nullIf(countIf(ev.event_type IN ('PostToolUse', 'PostToolUseFailure') AND ev.timestamp >= t.started_at), 0) AS error_rate_after
  FROM transitions t
  LEFT JOIN events_f ev ON ev.agent_name = t.agent_name AND ev.agent_version = t.current_version
  GROUP BY t.agent_name, t.current_version
),
events_before AS (
  SELECT t.agent_name, t.current_version,
    countIf(ev.event_type = 'PostToolUseFailure' AND ev.timestamp < t.started_at AND ev.timestamp >= t.prev_started_at) / nullIf(countIf(ev.event_type IN ('PostToolUse', 'PostToolUseFailure') AND ev.timestamp < t.started_at AND ev.timestamp >= t.prev_started_at), 0) AS error_rate_before
  FROM transitions t
  LEFT JOIN events_f ev ON ev.agent_name = t.agent_name AND ev.agent_version = t.prev_version
  GROUP BY t.agent_name, t.current_version
)
SELECT
  ua.agent_name, ua.prev_version, ua.current_version, ua.started_at,
  ub.avg_tokens_before, ua.avg_tokens_after,
  ub.avg_cost_before, ua.avg_cost_after,
  eb.error_rate_before, ea.error_rate_after
FROM usage_after ua
LEFT JOIN usage_before ub ON ub.agent_name = ua.agent_name AND ub.current_version = ua.current_version
LEFT JOIN events_after ea ON ea.agent_name = ua.agent_name AND ea.current_version = ua.current_version
LEFT JOIN events_before eb ON eb.agent_name = ua.agent_name AND eb.current_version = ua.current_version
ORDER BY ua.agent_name
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_23'

spec.title: Tokens by user

spec.title: Tokens by command over time
spec.description:
Goal: See which slash commands are the heaviest token consumers and whether that's changing.
Description: Buckets input/output tokens by time and command_name, one ↓/↑ series pair per command.

spec.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
    command_name AS metric,
    sum((input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (cache_creation_tokens + cache_read_tokens))) AS in_val,
    sum(output_tokens) AS out_val
  FROM agent_usage
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND command_name != ''
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
    AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
    AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_usage.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_usage.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_usage.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_usage.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))

    AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
    AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], mcp_tool_name))
  GROUP BY time, metric
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT time, concat(metric, ' ↓') AS metric, toInt64(in_val) AS value FROM filtered
  UNION ALL
  SELECT time, concat(metric, ' ↑') AS metric, toInt64(out_val) AS value FROM filtered
) ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_38'

spec.title: Failed tool calls
spec.description:
Goal: See recent individual tool-execution failures (not LLM-API-level failures) to debug what's actually breaking.
Description: Lists the most recent 20 agent_events rows with a non-empty failed_tool_name, showing failed_tool_args/failed_tool_error.
Recovered from message payloads at ingest time only, so this has no historical backfill - only shows failures from calls ingested after this panel was added.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp,
  user_id,
  session_id,
  dictGetOrDefault('ai_gateway_users_dict', 'user_name', user_id, '') AS user_name,
  failed_tool_name AS tool_name,
  failed_tool_args AS arguments,
  failed_tool_error AS error
FROM agent_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND failed_tool_name != ''
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
  AND (NOT startsWith(failed_tool_name, 'mcp__') OR (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], failed_tool_name)))
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 20
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_40'

spec.title: Tokens per call by agent/version (bloat detector)
spec.description:
Goal: Catch a prompt/tool-set regression that makes an agent version 'heavier' per call even if total volume looks flat.
Description: Averages input+output tokens per litellm_call, bucketed by time, per agent_name+agent_version - a rising line for the same agent means each individual call is getting more expensive, not just more frequent.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(u.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  if(u.agent_name = '', 'main agent', if(u.agent_version = '', u.agent_name, concat(u.agent_name, ' v', u.agent_version))) AS metric,
  avg((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens)) + u.output_tokens) AS value
FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND (u.agent_name != '' OR u.skill_name = '')
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_41'

spec.title: Prompt/response length by agent & skill (verbosity trend)
spec.description:
Goal: An early-warning signal for token bloat - text length grows before it shows up as a token-count regression, and it's readable without knowing model-specific tokenization.
Description: Averages character length of agent_messages.prompt_text/response_text per time bucket, grouped by skill_name (or agent_name when no skill applies).

spec.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    if(skill_name = '', if(agent_name = '', 'main agent', agent_name), skill_name) AS metric,
    length(prompt_text) AS prompt_len,
    length(response_text) AS response_len
  FROM agent_messages
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_messages.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_messages.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_messages.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_messages.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_messages.session_id IN (

      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(time, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time, concat(metric, ' prompt chars') AS metric, avg(prompt_len) AS value FROM filtered GROUP BY time, metric
  UNION ALL
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(time, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time, concat(metric, ' response chars') AS metric, avg(response_len) AS value FROM filtered GROUP BY time, metric
) ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_43'

spec.title: Cache efficiency ratio by agent/skill
spec.description:
Goal: Distinguish 'caching happened at all' (the existing cache-hit-rate panel) from 'how much of the prompt was actually served from cache', which is what determines the dollar savings.
Description: cache_read_tokens / input_tokens (input_tokens already includes cache_read + cache_creation), per time bucket, grouped by agent_name (or skill_name when no agent applies).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(u.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  if(u.agent_name = '', if(u.skill_name = '', 'main agent', u.skill_name), u.agent_name) AS metric,
  sum(u.cache_read_tokens) / nullIf(sum(u.input_tokens), 0) AS value
FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_44'

spec.title: Cache tokens saved
spec.description:
Goal: Quantify how many tokens were actually served from cache instead of being recomputed as fresh input, as a volume companion to the cache-hit-rate ratio panels.
Description: Sums agent_usage.cache_creation_tokens + cache_read_tokens (joined in from agent_usage via litellm_call_id) per time bucket, grouped by agent_name (or skill_name when no agent applies).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(agent_events.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  if(agent_events.agent_name = '', if(agent_events.skill_name = '', 'main agent', agent_events.skill_name), agent_events.agent_name) AS metric,
  sum(au.cache_creation_tokens + au.cache_read_tokens) AS value
FROM agent_events
LEFT JOIN agent_usage au ON au.litellm_call_id = agent_events.litellm_call_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(agent_events.timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], agent_events.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], agent_events.group_id))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_events.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], agent_events.skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], agent_events.command_name))
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_45'

spec.title: TTFT (time to first token) p50/p95 by model
spec.description:
Goal: Track model responsiveness (how long before the model starts streaming) separately from total call duration, which 'Latency percentiles by tool_name' already covers.
Description: p50/p95 of agent_usage.ttft_ms (completionStartTime - startTime) for rows with ttft_ms > 0, bucketed by time, per model.

spec.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT u.timestamp AS time, u.model AS metric, u.ttft_ms AS ttft_ms
  FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp) AND u.ttft_ms > 0
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(time, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time, concat(metric, ' p50') AS metric, quantile(0.5)(ttft_ms) AS value FROM filtered GROUP BY time, metric
  UNION ALL
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(time, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time, concat(metric, ' p95') AS metric, quantile(0.95)(ttft_ms) AS value FROM filtered GROUP BY time, metric
) ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_46'

spec.title: Stop-reason mix over time
spec.description:
Goal: Catch two failure modes a plain error-rate panel misses because the call still counts as 'success' - answers getting cut off (max_tokens) or refused (refusal) instead of ending cleanly.
Description: Stacked count of agent_usage.stop_reason per time bucket.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(u.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  u.stop_reason AS metric,
  count() AS value
FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp) AND u.stop_reason != ''
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_47'

spec.title: Retry / self-correction rate by agent & skill
spec.description:
Goal: A direct quality signal for a skill/prompt - how often the model has to react to its own failed tool call, versus succeeding cleanly the first time.
Description: Share of agent_events rows where failed_tool_name != '' (this call is responding to a tool_result marked is_error), per time bucket, grouped by agent_name (or skill_name when no agent applies).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  if(agent_name = '', if(skill_name = '', 'main agent', skill_name), agent_name) AS metric,
  countIf(failed_tool_name != '') / nullIf(count(), 0) AS value
FROM agent_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_48'

spec.title: API-level failure reasons over time
spec.description:
Goal: Tell platform-level failures (rate limits, overload, auth) apart from tool-execution failures, which never carry a tool_name since the call failed before any tool ran.
Description: Stacked count of agent_events rows with status='failure', grouped by error_type extracted from calculated_payload JSON, per time bucket.

spec.rawSql:
WITH failures AS (
  SELECT timestamp, agent_events.calculated_payload AS calculated_payload
  FROM agent_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND status = 'failure'
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
)
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  if(JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'error_type') = '', 'unknown', JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'error_type')) AS metric,
  count() AS value
FROM failures
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_49'

spec.title: Top repeating tool errors
spec.description:
Goal: 'Failed tool calls' lists individual failures - this instead groups them, so a single misbehaving tool call pattern (bad args, flaky dependency) shows up as one row with a count instead of many identical-looking entries.
Description: Groups agent_events by failed_tool_name + failed_tool_error, ranked by occurrence count, with the full error text available via the eye-icon column.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  failed_tool_name AS tool_name,
  count() AS occurrences,
  max(timestamp) AS last_seen,
  failed_tool_error
FROM agent_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND failed_tool_name != ''
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
  AND (NOT startsWith(failed_tool_name, 'mcp__') OR (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], failed_tool_name)))
GROUP BY tool_name, failed_tool_error
ORDER BY occurrences DESC
LIMIT 20
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_50'

spec.title: Command adoption
spec.description:
Goal: See which slash commands actually got adopted versus shipped-but-unused, which the token/cost-by-command trend panels don't answer directly.
Description: One row per command_name with call count, distinct session count, and first/last-seen timestamps, ranked by call count.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  command_name,
  count() AS calls,
  count(distinct session_id) AS sessions,
  min(timestamp) AS first_seen,
  max(timestamp) AS last_seen
FROM agent_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND command_name != ''
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
GROUP BY command_name
ORDER BY calls DESC
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_51'

spec.title: Subagent spawns over time by type
spec.description:
Goal: Catch an orchestrator/prompt change that starts spawning more (or fewer) subagents than before - a fan-out regression that token/cost panels only show indirectly.
Description: Counts agent_invocations rows (one per Agent tool_use recovered from the orchestrator's own messages) per time bucket, per subagent_type, inner-joined to a distinct session/user list from agent_events so the existing user/agent/skill/command filters still apply.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(ai.spawned_at, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  replaceRegexpOne(ai.subagent_type, '_(v[0-9][0-9.]*)$', ' \\1') AS metric,
  count() AS value
FROM agent_invocations ai
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT session_id, user_id
  FROM agent_events
  WHERE (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
    AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
    AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
    AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
) ev ON ev.session_id = ai.session_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(ai.spawned_at)
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], ai.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(ai.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(ai.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(ai.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR ai.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_52'

spec.title: Session cost distribution
spec.description:
Goal: 'Top 10 most expensive sessions' shows the outlier tail - this shows the overall shape, so it's possible to tell 'most sessions are cheap with a couple of expensive outliers' apart from 'costs are broadly high across the board'.
Description: Histogram of total cost per session_id (agent_usage.cost summed per session) over the selected time range.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT session_id, sum(cost) AS total_cost
FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
GROUP BY session_id
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_53'

spec.title: Top 10 models
spec.description:
Goal: See which models are most widely used and which drive the most spend.
Description: Counts distinct sessions and sums cost/tokens per model, ranked by cost descending, limited to 10.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  model,
  uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions,
  sum(cost) AS cost,
  sum((input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (cache_creation_tokens + cache_read_tokens))) AS tokens_input,
  sum(output_tokens) AS tokens_output
FROM agent_usage
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], mcp_tool_name))
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 10
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_94'

spec.title: Top 10 most expensive issues
spec.description:
Goal: Identify the costliest tracked issues (parsed from git branch names) to prioritize.
Description: Sums cost/tokens grouped by issue_id resolved via session_git_branch_dict, ranked by cost descending, limited to 10.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty') AS issue_id,
  sum(u.cost) AS cost,
  sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens))) AS tokens_input,
  sum(u.output_tokens) AS tokens_output
FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
GROUP BY issue_id
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 10
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_95'

spec.title: Tokens by model over time
spec.description:
Goal: Compare token usage across different models over time.
Description: Buckets input/output tokens by time and by u.model, rendering each model as a separate ↓/↑ series pair.

spec.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(u.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
    u.model AS metric,
    sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens))) AS in_val,
    sum(u.output_tokens) AS out_val
  FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
    AND (u.agent_name != '' OR u.skill_name = '')
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
    AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
    AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
    AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
    AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
    AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
  GROUP BY time, metric
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT time, concat(metric, ' ↓') AS metric, toInt64(in_val) AS value FROM filtered
  UNION ALL
  SELECT time, concat(metric, ' ↑') AS metric, toInt64(out_val) AS value FROM filtered
) ORDER BY time

spec.title: Fork tree: $session_id
spec.description:
Per-session fork tree: root is always the session's own initial user prompt text (system-reminder-stripped, command-tag-reconstructed, markdown/slash-command-highlighted, HTML-escaped - same rendering panel-76's Trace applies to its own real-user-prompt lines), shown as a plain non-collapsible line prefixed with the same yellow ❯ arrow panel-76 uses for a real user prompt, and each forked subagent (Task-tool spawn) renders as its own independently collapsible
/ element - collapsed by default to just its bold-named summary line with that fork's OWN stats only (tokens/duration/cost/model, not rolled up over descendants) - which expands to reveal its full, un-truncated task/prompt text plus any of its own child forks nested inside, each themselves independently collapsible. Depth/parent resolution has no real foreign key in the data model (agent_invocations has no column linking a spawn back to the parent tool_use call that triggered it), so it's resolved via the same best-effort ASOF-nearest-preceding-spawn heuristic used elsewhere in this dashboard (see panel-76's child_anchor pattern) - it can misattribute when multiple agents are spawned within the same message/turn. The anchor timestamp used per fork is the fork's own first real activity (min(agent_events.timestamp) where agent_invocation_id = that fork's agent_id), not agent_invocations.spawned_at - spawned_at was found, on real data, to sometimes be recorded chronologically AFTER a fork's own true first activity (agent_invocation_id can be reused across a background subagent's resumption calls, and agent_invocations is a ReplacingMergeTree with no FINAL applied here, so its spawned_at doesn't reliably reflect first use). ClickHouse has no WITH RECURSIVE, so parent/depth/sibling-position resolution is done in one pass via a bounded chain of 7 ancestor self-joins (n1..n7) - nesting deeper than 7 levels will not render correctly, though no real session has been seen anywhere near that deep. Preorder tree ordering and the box-drawing indent glyphs (├─/└─/│) are both derived from this same bounded ancestor chain: a string-concatenation sort key (one fixed-width zero-padded timestamp chunk per level, most distant ancestor first) so a parent's key is always a lexicographic prefix of all its descendants' keys, and a per-node is_last_sib flag propagated up the chain for correct multi-level indentation. The nested
/
structure (not just the flat glyph indentation) is built in one pass, no recursion: each fork's own 0-based depth (count of non-empty ancestors n1..n7) is compared against the next fork's depth in preorder (via leadInFrame(depth) over the session partitioned, sort_key-ordered window, with an explicit ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING frame since leadInFrame's default frame never sees past the current row) to compute how many
closing pairs trail this fork's own opening fragment - 0 if the next fork is this one's child (so its own
stays open to receive it), otherwise enough pairs to walk back up to just above whatever comes next (a sibling closes only this fork's own pair; an uncle, or the session's last fork, closes its whole open ancestor chain, since leadInFrame's out-of-frame default of 0 for a session's final fork is exactly the depth needed to close everything back to the root). Shows nothing when no session is selected.

spec.rawSql:
WITH selected AS ( SELECT '$session_id' AS session_id ), session_header AS ( SELECT s.session_id AS session_id, argMax(gb.git_branch, gb.captured_at) AS git_branch, argMax(gb.git_repo, gb.captured_at) AS git_repo, min(ev.timestamp) AS first_ts FROM selected s INNER JOIN agent_events ev ON ev.session_id = s.session_id LEFT JOIN session_git_branch gb ON gb.session_id = s.session_id GROUP BY s.session_id ), stats_tokens AS ( SELECT u.session_id AS session_id, sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens))) AS tok_in, sum(u.output_tokens) AS tok_out, sum(u.cost) AS cost_total, arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArray(u.model), ', ') AS models FROM agent_usage u INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = u.session_id WHERE u.model != '' GROUP BY u.session_id ), stats_time AS ( SELECT ev.session_id AS session_id, dateDiff('second', min(ev.timestamp), max(ev.timestamp)) AS dur_sec FROM agent_events ev INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = ev.session_id GROUP BY ev.session_id ), agent_names_raw AS ( SELECT ev.session_id AS session_id, ev.agent_name AS name FROM agent_events ev INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = ev.session_id WHERE ev.agent_name != '' UNION ALL SELECT ai.session_id AS session_id, splitByChar('_', ai.subagent_type)[1] AS name FROM agent_invocations ai INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = ai.session_id WHERE ai.subagent_type != '' AND splitByChar('_', ai.subagent_type)[1] != '' ), stats_agent_names AS ( SELECT session_id AS session_id, arrayStringConcat(arrayFilter(x -> x != '', groupUniqArray(name)), ', ') AS agents FROM agent_names_raw GROUP BY session_id ), session_stats AS ( SELECT st.session_id AS session_id, concat( 'StartedAt: ', formatDateTime(sh.first_ts, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S'), '\n', 'Duration: ', if(st.dur_sec >= 3600, concat(toString(intDiv(st.dur_sec, 3600)), 'h ', toString(intDiv(st.dur_sec % 3600, 60)), 'm'), if(st.dur_sec >= 60, concat(toString(intDiv(st.dur_sec, 60)), 'm ', toString(st.dur_sec % 60), 's'), concat(toString(st.dur_sec), 's'))), '\n', 'Cost: $', toString(round(coalesce(sk.cost_total, 0), 4)), '\n', 'Tokens: ', multiIf(coalesce(sk.tok_in, 0) >= 1000000, concat(toString(round(coalesce(sk.tok_in, 0) / 1000000., 1)), 'm'), coalesce(sk.tok_in, 0) >= 1000, concat(toString(round(coalesce(sk.tok_in, 0) / 1000., 1)), 'k'), toString(coalesce(sk.tok_in, 0))), ' in / ', multiIf(coalesce(sk.tok_out, 0) >= 1000000, concat(toString(round(coalesce(sk.tok_out, 0) / 1000000., 1)), 'm'), coalesce(sk.tok_out, 0) >= 1000, concat(toString(round(coalesce(sk.tok_out, 0) / 1000., 1)), 'k'), toString(coalesce(sk.tok_out, 0))), ' out\n', 'Model(s): ', coalesce(sk.models, ''), '\n', 'Agents: ', if(coalesce(an.agents, '') = '', 'none', an.agents), '\n', 'Git: ', if(coalesce(sh.git_repo, '') = '' AND coalesce(sh.git_branch, '') = '', 'unknown', concat(if(sh.git_repo != '', sh.git_repo, '?'), ':', if(sh.git_branch != '', sh.git_branch, '?'))) ) AS block FROM stats_time st LEFT JOIN stats_tokens sk ON sk.session_id = st.session_id LEFT JOIN stats_agent_names an ON an.session_id = st.session_id LEFT JOIN session_header sh ON sh.session_id = st.session_id ), fork_dedup AS ( SELECT ai.session_id AS session_id, ai.agent_id AS agent_id, argMax(ai.subagent_type, ai.spawned_at) AS subagent_type, argMax(ai.parent_agent_id, ai.spawned_at) AS parent_agent_id FROM agent_invocations ai INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = ai.session_id GROUP BY ai.session_id, ai.agent_id ), fork_start AS ( SELECT fd.session_id AS session_id, fd.agent_id AS agent_id, fd.subagent_type AS subagent_type, fd.parent_agent_id AS parent_agent_id, splitByChar('_', fd.subagent_type)[1] AS display_name, min(ev.timestamp) AS start_ts FROM fork_dedup fd INNER JOIN agent_events ev ON ev.session_id = fd.session_id AND ev.agent_invocation_id = fd.agent_id GROUP BY fd.session_id, fd.agent_id, fd.subagent_type, fd.parent_agent_id ), spawn_events AS ( SELECT ev.session_id AS session_id, ev.timestamp AS timestamp, ev.agent_invocation_id AS spawner_agent_id FROM agent_events ev INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = ev.session_id WHERE ev.calculated_type = 'agent_spawn' ), fork_parent_raw AS ( SELECT fs.session_id AS session_id, fs.agent_id AS agent_id, fs.subagent_type AS subagent_type, fs.display_name AS display_name, fs.start_ts AS start_ts, fs.parent_agent_id AS parent_agent_id_direct, se.spawner_agent_id AS parent_agent_id_asof FROM fork_start fs ASOF LEFT JOIN spawn_events se ON se.session_id = fs.session_id AND fs.start_ts > se.timestamp ), fork_parent_resolved AS ( SELECT session_id, agent_id, subagent_type, display_name, start_ts, if(parent_agent_id_direct IS NOT NULL, parent_agent_id_direct, coalesce(parent_agent_id_asof, '')) AS parent_id_pre FROM fork_parent_raw ), fork_parent AS ( SELECT session_id, agent_id, subagent_type, display_name, start_ts, if(parent_id_pre = agent_id, '', parent_id_pre) AS parent_agent_id FROM fork_parent_resolved ), fork_sib AS ( SELECT session_id, agent_id, parent_agent_id, start_ts, (row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, parent_agent_id ORDER BY start_ts) = count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, parent_agent_id)) AS is_last_sib FROM fork_parent ), fork_full AS ( SELECT fp.session_id, fp.agent_id, fp.display_name, fp.start_ts, fp.parent_agent_id, fsib.is_last_sib FROM fork_parent fp INNER JOIN fork_sib fsib ON fsib.session_id = fp.session_id AND fsib.agent_id = fp.agent_id ), fork_chain AS ( SELECT n0.session_id AS session_id, n0.agent_id AS agent_id, n0.display_name AS display_name, n0.start_ts AS start_ts, n0.is_last_sib AS is_last_sib, concat( if(n7.agent_id != '', ' ', ''), if(n6.agent_id != '', ' ', ''), if(n5.agent_id != '', ' ', ''), if(n4.agent_id != '', ' ', ''), if(n3.agent_id != '', ' ', ''), if(n2.agent_id != '', ' ', ''), if(n1.agent_id != '', ' ', '') ) AS indent_prefix, concat( if(n7.agent_id != '', leftPad(toString(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(n7.start_ts)), 20, '0'), ''), if(n6.agent_id != '', leftPad(toString(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(n6.start_ts)), 20, '0'), ''), if(n5.agent_id != '', leftPad(toString(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(n5.start_ts)), 20, '0'), ''), if(n4.agent_id != '', leftPad(toString(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(n4.start_ts)), 20, '0'), ''), if(n3.agent_id != '', leftPad(toString(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(n3.start_ts)), 20, '0'), ''), if(n2.agent_id != '', leftPad(toString(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(n2.start_ts)), 20, '0'), ''), if(n1.agent_id != '', leftPad(toString(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(n1.start_ts)), 20, '0'), ''), leftPad(toString(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(n0.start_ts)), 20, '0') ) AS sort_key, ( toUInt16(n1.agent_id != '') + toUInt16(n2.agent_id != '') + toUInt16(n3.agent_id != '') + toUInt16(n4.agent_id != '') + toUInt16(n5.agent_id != '') + toUInt16(n6.agent_id != '') + toUInt16(n7.agent_id != '') ) AS depth FROM fork_full n0 LEFT JOIN fork_full n1 ON n1.session_id = n0.session_id AND n1.agent_id = n0.parent_agent_id LEFT JOIN fork_full n2 ON n2.session_id = n0.session_id AND n2.agent_id = n1.parent_agent_id LEFT JOIN fork_full n3 ON n3.session_id = n0.session_id AND n3.agent_id = n2.parent_agent_id LEFT JOIN fork_full n4 ON n4.session_id = n0.session_id AND n4.agent_id = n3.parent_agent_id LEFT JOIN fork_full n5 ON n5.session_id = n0.session_id AND n5.agent_id = n4.parent_agent_id LEFT JOIN fork_full n6 ON n6.session_id = n0.session_id AND n6.agent_id = n5.parent_agent_id LEFT JOIN fork_full n7 ON n7.session_id = n0.session_id AND n7.agent_id = n6.parent_agent_id ), fork_usage AS ( SELECT u.session_id AS session_id, u.agent_invocation_id AS agent_id, sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens)) + u.output_tokens) AS tok, sum(u.cost) AS cost, arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArray(u.model), ', ') AS models FROM agent_usage u INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = u.session_id WHERE u.agent_invocation_id != '' GROUP BY u.session_id, u.agent_invocation_id ), fork_duration AS ( SELECT ev.session_id AS session_id, ev.agent_invocation_id AS agent_id, max(ev.timestamp) AS last_ts FROM agent_events ev INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = ev.session_id WHERE ev.agent_invocation_id != '' GROUP BY ev.session_id, ev.agent_invocation_id ), fork_prompt_rn AS ( -- row_number() needs the full per-fork partition to assign order, but the -- expensive multi-pass regex-stripping below (system-reminder strip, -- whitespace collapse, blank-line collapse, trim) does NOT need to run on -- every row in that partition - only on the one (rn=1) row actually kept. -- Doing the strip before the rn=1 filter (the previous, single-CTE shape -- of this logic) applied 4 regex passes to every prompt message in the -- session - hundreds of rows, some tens of KB each - even though only the -- first message per fork survives downstream. Measured live: this was the -- dominant cost in panel-99's query, pushing total runtime past -- ClickHouse's/Grafana's query timeout on sessions with many/large -- prompts and rendering nothing at all (the original bug report). SELECT m.session_id AS session_id, m.agent_invocation_id AS agent_id, m.prompt_text AS prompt_text_raw, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY m.session_id, m.agent_invocation_id ORDER BY m.timestamp) AS rn FROM agent_messages m INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = m.session_id WHERE m.agent_invocation_id != '' AND m.prompt_text != '' ), fork_prompt AS ( -- Strips harness/system noise directly from agent_messages.prompt_text -- (NOT via agent_events.calculated_payload.display_text - that field was -- found, on live data, to sometimes carry a LATER call's text for the -- same agent_invocation_id, a separate ingest-side join/dedup bug that's -- out of scope here). Strips every ... -- occurrence anywhere in the text (not just a leading one - unlike -- panel-76's tool_result_preview, a fork's task prompt can have more than -- one), then collapses whitespace the same way services/_common/src/ingest_parsing.py's own -- _collapse_whitespace does (spaces/tabs runs -> single space, blank-line -- runs -> single newline), then trims leading/trailing newlines/spaces -- left behind by the strip. Only applied to the rn=1 row per fork - see -- fork_prompt_rn's own comment above for why this is split out. SELECT session_id, agent_id, replaceRegexpOne( replaceRegexpOne( replaceRegexpAll( replaceRegexpAll(prompt_text_raw, '(?s).*?', ''), '[ \t]+', ' ' ), '\n{2,}', '\n' ), '^[\n ]+|[\n ]+$', '' ) AS prompt_text FROM fork_prompt_rn WHERE rn = 1 ), main_prompt_rn AS ( -- Same rn-before-regex split as fork_prompt_rn above, and for the same -- measured reason: the session's own top-level thread can have just as -- many/large messages as any fork, so stripping/collapsing every one of -- them before keeping only rn=1 wastes the identical amount of work. SELECT m.session_id AS session_id, m.prompt_text AS prompt_text_raw, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY m.session_id ORDER BY m.timestamp) AS rn FROM agent_messages m INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = m.session_id WHERE m.agent_invocation_id = '' AND m.prompt_text != '' ), main_prompt_pre AS ( -- Root-thread first-message text: mirrors fork_prompt's own -- system-reminder-stripping/whitespace-collapsing pipeline, scoped to the -- session's own top-level thread (agent_invocation_id = '') instead of a -- fork's task prompt. Only applied to the rn=1 row - see main_prompt_rn's -- own comment above. -- -- Also mirrors the / reconstruction -- panel-76's own prompt_kind='command' display text applies at ingest -- (_prompt_kind_and_display in services/_common/src/ingest_parsing.py) - -- a slash-command invocation's raw prompt_text wraps the command name and -- its typed arguments in Claude Code's own / -- tags (e.g. /goal ... do the -- thing), which must never render as literal XML - it has -- to be reconstructed into a plain "/command args" line instead, same as -- panel-76 shows.
