spec.title: Spend by branch
spec.description:
Goal: See which git branch is costing the most.
Description: Sums cost/tokens grouped by git_branch resolved via session_git_branch_dict, ranked by cost descending.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), '(none - no branch captured)') AS git_branch,
  sum(u.cost) AS cost,
  sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens)) + u.output_tokens) AS tokens
FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
GROUP BY git_branch
ORDER BY cost DESC
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_54'

spec.title: Cost over time by branch
spec.description:
Goal: See when a branch's spend happened and whether it's trending up or tapering off, not just the total.
Description: Sums cost per time bucket, one series per git_branch resolved via session_git_branch_dict.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(u.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), '(none - no branch captured)') AS metric,
  sum(u.cost) AS value
FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_55'

spec.title: Sessions by branch
spec.description:
Goal: See which branches are actually being worked in, as opposed to which cost the most.
Description: Counts distinct session_id grouped by git_branch, ranked by sessions descending.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), '(none - no branch captured)') AS git_branch,
  count(DISTINCT u.session_id) AS sessions
FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
GROUP BY git_branch
ORDER BY sessions DESC
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_56'

Description: Sums tokens/cost grouped by git_branch, ranked by tokens descending.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), '(none - no branch captured)') AS git_branch,
  sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens)) + u.output_tokens) AS tokens,
  sum(u.cost) AS cost
FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
GROUP BY git_branch
ORDER BY tokens DESC
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_57'

spec.title: Cost by subagent type over time
spec.description:
Goal: See which subagent types actually drive spend.
Description: Inner-joins agent_usage.agent_invocation_id to agent_invocations.agent_id to resolve subagent_type, sums cost per time bucket grouped by that type - the same join key already used elsewhere in the schema but not previously wired into any panel, so this cost was invisible before.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(u.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  ai.subagent_type AS metric,
  sum(u.cost) AS value
FROM agent_usage u
INNER JOIN agent_invocations ai ON ai.agent_id = u.agent_invocation_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND u.agent_invocation_id != ''
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_58'

spec.title: Tokens by subagent type over time

  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')

  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))

SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_59'

spec.title: Top subagent types by cost
spec.description:
Goal: Rank subagent types to decide which is worth optimizing first.
Description: Same agent_invocations join, aggregated to totals (cost, tokens, call count) over the whole selected range, ranked by cost descending, limited to 15.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  ai.subagent_type AS subagent_type,
  sum(u.cost) AS cost,
  sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens)) + u.output_tokens) AS tokens,
  count() AS calls
FROM agent_usage u
INNER JOIN agent_invocations ai ON ai.agent_id = u.agent_invocation_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND u.agent_invocation_id != ''
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
GROUP BY subagent_type
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 15
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_60'

spec.title: Subagent call outcome by type (success/failure)
spec.description:
Goal: Spot a subagent type whose calls fail disproportionately.
Description: Counts agent_events rows per time bucket, grouped by subagent_type (via the agent_invocation_id -> agent_id join) concatenated with status, so success/failure trends per type are visible side by side.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(e.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  concat(ai.subagent_type, ' - ', e.status) AS metric,
  count() AS value
FROM agent_events e
INNER JOIN agent_invocations ai ON ai.agent_id = e.agent_invocation_id

spec.title: Cache creation tokens by TTL (1h vs 5m)
spec.description:
Goal: See how much prompt-cache writing goes to the cheaper-but-longer-lived 1h tier vs the 5m tier that expires between widely-spaced requests.
Description: Unions two per-time-bucket sums, cache_creation_1h_tokens and cache_creation_5m_tokens, as separate series; a rising 5m share usually means requests are landing far enough apart that the longer cache window isn't being reused.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(u.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
    'ephemeral 1h' AS metric,
    sum(u.cache_creation_1h_tokens) AS value
  FROM agent_usage u
  WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
    AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
    AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
    AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  GROUP BY time
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(u.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
    'ephemeral 5m' AS metric,
    sum(u.cache_creation_5m_tokens) AS value
  FROM agent_usage u
  WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
    AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
    AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))

spec.title: /goal usage log
spec.description:
Goal: See the detail behind each individual /goal invocation - who ran it, how long it took, and what was asked.
Description: One row per session (= one invocation, since turn_id is currently always 0): joins per-session call count/duration from agent_events to input/output token and cost totals from agent_usage and the first prompt text extracted from calculated_payload. Click the value in 'arguments' to see the full text.

spec.rawSql:
WITH goal_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    agent_events.session_id AS session_id,
    min(timestamp) AS started_at,
    max(timestamp) AS last_call_at,
    count() AS calls,
    any(agent_events.user_id) AS session_user_id,
    any(dictGetOrDefault('ai_gateway_users_dict', 'user_name', agent_events.user_id, '')) AS session_user_name
  FROM agent_events
  WHERE command_name = 'goal'
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], agent_events.user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
    AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  GROUP BY agent_events.session_id
),
prompts AS (
  SELECT session_id,
    argMin(replaceRegexpOne(JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'display_text'), '^/goal ', ''), timestamp) AS prompt_text
  FROM agent_events
  WHERE command_name = 'goal' AND JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'display_text') != ''
  GROUP BY session_id
),
usage AS (
  SELECT session_id, sum((input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (cache_creation_tokens + cache_read_tokens))) AS tokens_input, sum(output_tokens) AS tokens_output, sum(cost) AS cost
  FROM agent_usage
  GROUP BY session_id
)
SELECT
  gs.started_at AS timestamp,
  gs.session_user_id AS user_id,
  gs.session_id AS session_id,
  gs.session_user_name AS user_name,
  gs.calls AS "llm calls",
  round(dateDiff('second', gs.started_at, gs.last_call_at) / 60.0, 2) AS "duration (min)",
  coalesce(u.tokens_input, 0) AS tokens_input,
  coalesce(u.tokens_output, 0) AS tokens_output,
  coalesce(u.cost, 0) AS cost,
  p.prompt_text AS "arguments"
FROM goal_sessions gs
LEFT JOIN prompts p ON p.session_id = gs.session_id
LEFT JOIN usage u ON u.session_id = gs.session_id
ORDER BY gs.started_at DESC
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_68'

  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))

spec.title: Tokens by repo
spec.description:
Goal: See token volume per repo as a companion to spend - a repo can be token-heavy but cheap on a cache-friendly model, or vice versa.
Description: Sums tokens/cost grouped by git_repo, ranked by tokens descending.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), '(none - no repo captured)') AS git_repo,
  sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens)) + u.output_tokens) AS tokens,
  sum(u.cost) AS cost
FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
GROUP BY git_repo
ORDER BY tokens DESC
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_72'

    )) AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name)) AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name)) AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name)) AND (NOT startsWith(tool_name, 'mcp__') OR (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], tool_name)))

spec.title: Trace: $session_id
spec.description: One call tree per session, monospace. Right after the header comes a session summary block (duration, cost, tokens in/out, models, prompt count, tool-call count, agents/skills used - two values per line). User prompts/comments and model replies are shown in full (no truncation) and wrap across lines in the viewer; only tool-call argument previews stay short and column-aligned with a right-hand stats block, since a reply/prompt of unbounded length can't share that fixed-width column without being cut back down. Everything before the session's first genuine (non-harness) user message is dropped - a silent auto-retry or warm-up call that never showed up in the CLI itself would otherwise appear as a confusing orphan row. Timestamps only on important nodes - user prompts/comments (marked ● when real, ○ when it's harness-injected noise: goal-check judge calls, suggestion-mode prompts, background stop-hook notifications, conversation-title-generation calls - best-effort detection, not exhaustive, since agent_messages.prompt_text captures any 'user'-role turn verbatim, harness boilerplate included - see _last_user_text's docstring in services/_common/src/ingest_parsing.py), agent spawns, and replies - not every plain tool call. A leading <system-reminder>...</system-reminder> block is stripped before display, and a <command-args> block is shown as '/command <args>' when present. Tool calls prefer showing their file_path argument when one exists. A row whose own LLM call failed (status='failure') shows the error type read directly from calculated_payload's error_type key (e.g. rate_limit_error) instead of blank - this is precomputed once at ingest by _error_type in services/_common/src/ingest_parsing.py from the same error_information the payload always carried, no join needed - distinct from a row with failed_tool_name/failed_tool_error set, which means THIS call succeeded but is reacting to a tool that failed one step earlier (shown as an indented 🚨 note above the row) - the two are not the same thing, see the failed_tool_* column comments in schema.sql. Prompt classification (real/command/judge_call/system_notification/suggestion_mode/transcript_handoff/title_gen/interrupted/webpage_content), the cleaned display text, and each tool call's main argument preview are likewise all read directly from calculated_payload's prompt_kind/display_text/tool_display_arg keys (precomputed once at ingest by _prompt_kind_and_display/_tool_display_arg), not recomputed via regex/JSON-preference-chain logic in this panel's own SQL. Latency/tokens/cost are dimmed (opacity) and tokens are abbreviated (12.3k tok); latency shows in seconds once past 100ms. Shows nothing when no session is selected, one tree for a single session, one tree per session when "All" is selected (bounded by the session_id variable's own 200-session cap). Agent-spawn attribution (which agent_invocations row belongs to which Agent tool_use call) is a best-effort ASOF match on nearest spawned_at, not a real parent link. Nesting is a single level - the data model has no parent link for a sub-sub-agent.

spec.rawSql:
WITH selected AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session_id FROM agent_events
  WHERE (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], session_id))
),
dedup_messages AS (
  -- agent_messages is a ReplacingMergeTree(ingested_at) ORDER BY (session_id,
  -- litellm_call_id) - a reparse job that re-INSERTs a corrected row (rather
  -- than replacing in place) leaves both the old and new row physically
  -- present until a background merge (or an explicit FINAL/OPTIMIZE) collapses
  -- them; a plain equality JOIN against the raw table sees BOTH rows and
  -- silently double-renders (or even triples/quadruples) every prompt/reply
  -- line for that call - reproduced live against this very dashboard's own
  -- session trace, not just the reported Codex/chatgpt sessions, since
  -- agent_messages accumulates un-merged duplicate rows broadly whenever
  -- ingestion runs more than once for the same litellm_call_id. Same root
  -- cause and same fix pattern as child_anchor's own dedup of
  -- agent_invocations above (also a ReplacingMergeTree with no FINAL applied
  -- here) - argMax by ingested_at picks the single latest-ingested row per
  -- (session_id, litellm_call_id), mirroring what the table's own version
  -- column would resolve to once merged.
  SELECT m2.session_id AS session_id, m2.litellm_call_id AS litellm_call_id,
    argMax(m2.prompt_text, m2.ingested_at) AS prompt_text,
    argMax(m2.response_text, m2.ingested_at) AS response_text
  FROM agent_messages m2
  INNER JOIN selected s2 ON s2.session_id = m2.session_id
  WHERE m2.litellm_call_id != ''
  GROUP BY m2.session_id, m2.litellm_call_id
),
scoped_events AS (
  SELECT
    ev.session_id AS session_id, ev.timestamp AS timestamp, ev.tool_name AS tool_name,
    ev.litellm_call_id AS litellm_call_id,
    ev.agent_invocation_id AS agent_invocation_id, ev.command_name AS command_name,
    ev.status AS status, ev.latency_ms AS latency_ms,
    ev.calculated_type AS calculated_type, ev.calculated_payload AS calculated_payload,
    ev.failed_tool_name AS failed_tool_name, ev.failed_tool_error AS failed_tool_error,
    m.prompt_text AS prompt_text, m.response_text AS response_text,
    -- Bug fix: dedup must catch a prompt_text reappearing anywhere earlier in
    -- this same (session_id, agent_invocation_id), not merely on the
    -- immediately-preceding row - a lagInFrame-based "differs from the row
    -- right before it" check misses the case where an unrelated row (a
    -- system_notification, a suggestion_mode prompt, ...) is sandwiched
    -- between two calls that both still carry the same underlying real user
    -- message in context, which let that message re-render as a spurious
    -- duplicate ❯ marker further down the trace. min(timestamp) OVER a
    -- partition keyed on the exact prompt_text itself (no ORDER BY, so the
    -- frame is the whole partition) gives the timestamp of that text's FIRST
    -- occurrence anywhere in this agent_invocation_id; a row is the one that
    -- should render as a marker iff its own timestamp equals that minimum,
    -- i.e. it IS the first occurrence - exactly the "was this exact
    -- prompt_text already shown at any earlier point" check needed, not just
    -- "differs from my immediate predecessor".
    min(ev.timestamp) OVER (
      PARTITION BY ev.session_id, ev.agent_invocation_id, m.prompt_text
    ) AS first_prompt_occurrence_ts,
    -- Bug fix (4th "Prompts:" inflation bug): a prompt_kind='command' row's
    -- RAW prompt_text can legitimately change between Codex's own repeated
    -- self-resends of the SAME command invocation, because harness wrappers
    -- like <codex_internal_context source="goal"> embed a live, changing
    -- token-budget counter ("Tokens used: N") inside the raw text itself -
    -- confirmed against real session 019f9b12-411f-7193-b498-28f5367df9a8,
    -- where the same /goal continuation was auto-resent by Codex (no new
    -- human input) with prompt_text lengths 5400 then 5404 (4 extra digits
    -- from the counter), defeating first_prompt_occurrence_ts's byte-exact
    -- dedup above and counting one ongoing /goal prompt as multiple. The
    -- ingest-computed display_text (calculated_payload) is already stripped
    -- of this noise for command-kind rows (see _prompt_kind_and_display in
    -- services/_common/src/ingest_parsing.py) - two command rows with the same command_name +
    -- display_text are the same underlying prompt, just resent, so dedup
    -- them on that clean key instead of raw prompt_text. Only used for
    -- prompt_kind='command' rows (selected via effective_first_prompt_ts in
    -- prompt_calc below) - real/freeform human prompts keep the existing
    -- byte-exact dedup unchanged, since they don't have this changing-
    -- counter problem.
    min(ev.timestamp) OVER (
      PARTITION BY ev.session_id, ev.agent_invocation_id, ev.command_name,
        JSONExtractString(ev.calculated_payload, 'display_text')
    ) AS first_command_occurrence_ts,
    -- A newly-spawned subagent's own conversation begins with a "user"-role
    -- message that is actually the task/prompt the orchestrator's model
    -- handed it via the Agent tool_use's own arguments - not anything a
    -- human typed. Every subsequent turn inside that subagent still resolves
    -- to this same text as its "last human-originated" turn (no further
    -- genuine human input ever arrives mid-subagent), so it only survives
    -- prompt_calc's dedup once, on the very first row of the invocation.
    -- row_number()=1 within (session_id, agent_invocation_id) identifies
    -- that first row, used below (is_agent_task) to render it with the
    -- assistant-text marker/style instead of the real-user-prompt ❯ marker.
    row_number() OVER (
      PARTITION BY ev.session_id, ev.agent_invocation_id ORDER BY ev.timestamp
    ) AS rn_in_invocation
  FROM agent_events ev
  INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = ev.session_id
  -- litellm_call_id (unique per call, confirmed) replaces the old
  -- m.timestamp = ev.timestamp equality join, which could silently pair a
  -- row with the wrong agent_messages row whenever two calls landed in the
  -- same millisecond (parallel subagent dispatch, MCP call bursts) - both
  -- tables now carry litellm_call_id in their ORDER BY for exactly this
  -- reason. Guarded by ev.litellm_call_id != '' so a row ingested before
  -- this column existed (permanently blank - see schema.sql's agent_events
  -- comment) simply fails to join rather than colliding with every other
  -- blank-call-id row in the same session.
  LEFT JOIN dedup_messages m ON m.session_id = ev.session_id
    AND ev.litellm_call_id != '' AND m.litellm_call_id = ev.litellm_call_id
),
usage_by_call AS (
  SELECT u.session_id AS session_id, u.litellm_call_id AS litellm_call_id,
    sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens)) + u.output_tokens) AS tok, sum(u.cost) AS cost
  FROM agent_usage u
  INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = u.session_id
  WHERE u.litellm_call_id != ''
  GROUP BY u.session_id, u.litellm_call_id
),
-- A background subagent runs concurrently with the orchestrator's own
-- continued work, so sorting every row purely by its own real timestamp
-- interleaves two unrelated threads of activity (the subagent's steps and
-- whatever the orchestrator did *while waiting*) into one jumbled stream.
-- child_anchor gives every agent_invocation_id a single "anchor" timestamp
-- - the orchestrator's own nearest-preceding Agent-spawn row - so the
-- whole subagent block sorts as one contiguous unit right after its spawn
-- point, instead of scattering across the orchestrator's concurrent rows.
-- agent_invocations.parent_agent_id (populated at ingest from the caller's
-- own x-claude-code-agent-id header) gives a real parent link for every row
-- ingested after that column's rollout - NULL only on pre-migration/legacy
-- rows, where this remains the same nearest-preceding ASOF heuristic as
-- before (no real parent link exists for those - see agent_invocations' own
-- comment in schema.sql), not one of the equality joins fixed by
-- litellm_call_id above.
agent_spawn_events AS (
  SELECT ev.session_id AS session_id, ev.timestamp AS timestamp,
    ev.agent_invocation_id AS spawner_agent_id
  FROM agent_events ev
  INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = ev.session_id
  WHERE ev.calculated_type = 'agent_spawn'
),
child_anchor_raw AS (
  SELECT ai.session_id AS session_id, ai.agent_id AS agent_id, se.timestamp AS anchor_ts
  FROM agent_invocations ai
  INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = ai.session_id
  ASOF LEFT JOIN agent_spawn_events se
    ON se.session_id = ai.session_id AND se.spawner_agent_id = coalesce(ai.parent_agent_id, '')
      AND ai.spawned_at >= se.timestamp
),
child_anchor AS (
  -- agent_invocations can carry more than one row per agent_id (no FINAL
  -- applied to its ReplacingMergeTree here) - dedup to exactly one row per
  -- (session_id, agent_id) or the later join in the final SELECT would
  -- silently multiply every one of that subagent's event rows.
  SELECT session_id, agent_id,
    if(any(anchor_ts) = toDateTime64('1970-01-01 00:00:00', 3), NULL, any(anchor_ts)) AS anchor_ts
  FROM child_anchor_raw
  GROUP BY session_id, agent_id
),
-- ExitPlanMode's own tool-call args don't carry the plan text (only an
-- optional, now-deprecated freeform allowedPrompts field) - plan_proposals
-- stores every plan text captured during the session, and there can be MORE
-- plan_proposals rows than ExitPlanMode calls (intermediate revisions never
-- submitted), so matching an ExitPlanMode row to "the plan it actually
-- submitted" is a genuine ASOF heuristic (nearest-preceding captured_at),
-- same pattern as child_anchor_raw above - not an exact link.
plan_proposals_match AS (
  SELECT sr.session_id AS session_id, sr.litellm_call_id AS litellm_call_id, pp.plan_text AS plan_text
  FROM scoped_events sr
  INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = sr.session_id
  ASOF LEFT JOIN plan_proposals pp
    ON pp.session_id = sr.session_id AND pp.captured_at <= sr.timestamp
  WHERE sr.tool_name = 'ExitPlanMode'
),
session_header AS (
  SELECT s.session_id AS session_id, any(ev.user_id) AS user_id,
    argMax(gb.git_branch, gb.captured_at) AS git_branch,
    argMax(gb.git_repo, gb.captured_at) AS git_repo,
    min(ev.timestamp) AS first_ts
  FROM selected s
  INNER JOIN agent_events ev ON ev.session_id = s.session_id
  LEFT JOIN session_git_branch gb ON gb.session_id = s.session_id
  GROUP BY s.session_id
),
stats_tokens AS (
  SELECT u.session_id AS session_id, sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens))) AS tok_in, sum(u.output_tokens) AS tok_out, sum(u.cost) AS cost_total,
    arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArray(u.model), ', ') AS models
  FROM agent_usage u INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = u.session_id
  WHERE u.model != ''
  GROUP BY u.session_id
),
-- agent_events.agent_name is blank whenever the subagent's own rows raced
-- ahead of the orchestrator's Agent tool_use/tool_result (best-effort lookup,
-- see _agent_name_and_version_for_invocation's docstring in
-- services/_common/src/ingest_db.py) - agent_invocations.subagent_type is the reliable
-- source of "which subagents actually ran", so the two are unioned rather
-- than trusting agent_events alone.
agent_names_raw AS (
  SELECT ev.session_id AS session_id, ev.agent_name AS name
  FROM agent_events ev INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = ev.session_id
  WHERE ev.agent_name != ''

  UNION ALL

  SELECT ai.session_id AS session_id, splitByChar('_', ai.subagent_type)[1] AS name
  FROM agent_invocations ai INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = ai.session_id
  WHERE ai.subagent_type != '' AND splitByChar('_', ai.subagent_type)[1] != ''
),
stats_agent_names AS (
  -- arrayFilter is defense-in-depth against any stray '' sneaking into the
  -- array (e.g. a future source added to the UNION above without its own
  -- empty-string guard) - arrayStringConcat would otherwise render it as a
  -- trailing ", " with nothing after it.
  SELECT session_id AS session_id, arrayStringConcat(arrayFilter(x -> x != '', groupUniqArray(name)), ', ') AS agents
  FROM agent_names_raw
  GROUP BY session_id
),
stats_skills AS (
  SELECT ev.session_id AS session_id,
    arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArrayIf(ev.skill_name, ev.skill_name != ''), ', ') AS skills
  FROM agent_events ev INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = ev.session_id
  GROUP BY ev.session_id
),
stats_time AS (
  SELECT ev.session_id AS session_id,
    dateDiff('second', min(ev.timestamp), max(ev.timestamp)) AS dur_sec,
    countIf(ev.tool_name != '') AS n_tools
  FROM agent_events ev INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = ev.session_id
  GROUP BY ev.session_id
),
-- prompt_calc/prompt_final are computed here (moved ahead of session_stats) so
-- that stats_prompts below can reuse the same is_real classification used for
-- the tie=2 marker glyph (❯ vs ○/●/🧐), instead of a separate, cruder "any row
-- with prompt_text" count that lumps real user requests together with
-- sys-checks/title-gen/suggestion-mode/judge calls.
-- prompt_kind/display_text are read directly from calculated_payload, computed
-- once at ingest by _prompt_kind_and_display in services/_common/src/ingest_parsing.py - a
-- line-for-line port of this CTE pair's own former regex-based text-cleaning/
-- classification chain (system-reminder stripping, command-args extraction,
-- interrupted-prefix stripping, summary/status tag extraction, whitespace/
-- blank-line collapsing, per-branch truncation). prompt_kind is deliberately
-- NOT the same thing as calculated_type: calculated_type prioritizes "did this
-- call's own response invoke a tool" over "what did the prompt that triggered
-- it look like", so a system-notification/judge-call/etc prompt whose response
-- happened to also call a tool used to get misclassified here as a real user
-- prompt when this logic read is_sys/is_real off calculated_type. prompt_kind
-- fixes that by always re-deriving the prompt's own shape from prompt_text,
-- independently of calculated_type, exactly like the old regex chain did.
prompt_calc AS (
  SELECT sr.session_id, sr.timestamp AS ts, sr.litellm_call_id AS litellm_call_id,
    sr.agent_invocation_id AS agent_invocation_id,
    JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'prompt_kind') AS prompt_kind,
    JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'display_text') AS display_text,
    -- Bug fix (3rd "Prompts:" inflation bug): _prompt_kind_and_display (the
    -- ingest-side classifier, services/_common/src/ingest_parsing.py) runs an UNANCHORED
    -- regex search for <command-args>...</command-args> ANYWHERE in the
    -- prompt text, before it ever checks whether the prompt is actually a
    -- <transcript>-wrapped background severity check or a "this session is
    -- being continued from a previous conversation" compaction summary -
    -- both of which routinely echo an earlier /command invocation's own
    -- <command-args> tag verbatim as part of the quoted history they carry.
    -- That misclassifies dozens of harness-internal re-sends per session as
    -- fresh prompt_kind='command' (i.e. is_real) rows, and each one has
    -- slightly different byte content (growing transcript/context), so the
    -- byte-exact first_prompt_occurrence_ts dedup above doesn't collapse
    -- them either - together these inflated one single /goal submission
    -- into ~17 counted "Prompts" in a real session. This is a genuine
    -- ingest-side classification bug (see this panel's own doc / AGENTS.md
    -- for the full writeup) - out of scope to fix in services/_common/src/ingest_parsing.py
    -- from here, but directly detectable and worth suppressing at query
    -- time: a GENUINE top-level /command invocation never itself contains
    -- a nested <transcript> block or a "session is being continued" resume
    -- marker, so a 'command'-kind row containing either is, with no
    -- observed counterexample across multiple real sessions checked, a
    -- harness re-echo, not a new human command submission.
    (JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'prompt_kind') = 'command'
      AND (position(sr.prompt_text, '<transcript>') > 0
        OR position(sr.prompt_text, 'This session is being continued from') > 0)
    ) AS is_command_echo,
    -- display_arg is the variable "gray argument" part of the line (severity
    -- score, agent-completion summary, ...), computed once at ingest by
    -- _prompt_kind_and_display alongside display_text - shown the same way
    -- tool_render shows a tool's own argument (a dimmed span after the fixed
    -- label/name), rather than being fused into display_text as plain-color
    -- text. Empty string for most prompt_kind rows (judge_call, title_gen,
    -- real user prompts, most system_notification branches, etc.), which
    -- render exactly as before with no added span.
    JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'display_arg') AS display_arg,
    -- judge_ok/judge_reason: precomputed at ingest alongside prompt_kind for
    -- judge_call rows (the /goal judge's verdict and its free-text
    -- rationale). has_judge_ok distinguishes "key absent" (older
    -- un-reparsed rows, predating this field - show neither 👍 nor 👎) from
    -- an explicit false (JSONExtractBool alone can't tell these apart: it
    -- returns false for both a real `false` value and a missing key).
    JSONHas(sr.calculated_payload, 'judge_ok') AS has_judge_ok,
    JSONExtractBool(sr.calculated_payload, 'judge_ok') AS judge_ok,
    JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'judge_reason') AS judge_reason,
    -- stop_hook_reason: precomputed at ingest for stop_hook_feedback rows (the
    -- model's own free-text assessment of whether the stop condition was
    -- met, extracted from the injected prompt itself via _STOP_HOOK_REASON_RE
    -- - see services/_common/src/ingest_parsing.py). Shown in full, unlike judge_reason, per
    -- this panel's own convention (no truncation cap for this field).
    JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'stop_hook_reason') AS stop_hook_reason,
    (sr.agent_invocation_id != '' AND sr.rn_in_invocation = 1) AS is_agent_task,
    -- Bug fix: when the previous assistant turn called a tool, the Claude API
    -- puts that tool_result block into the NEXT request's "user" role.
    -- Claude Code sometimes appends a second content block alongside it (a
    -- bare system-reminder, a skill's own tool_result content rendered as a
    -- separate text block, etc.), so _last_user_text's own "all blocks are
    -- tool_result" skip (services/_common/src/ingest_parsing.py) doesn't catch it and
    -- prompt_text ends up literally "[tool_result]\n<whatever was attached>".
    -- This is never anything a human typed.
    -- None of _prompt_kind_and_display's prefix branches recognize this
    -- literal marker (it isn't a Claude Code lifecycle convention like
    -- system_notification/judge_call/etc.), so it falls through to
    -- prompt_kind='real' and used to render with the same real-user ❯ marker
    -- as a genuine prompt, get counted in "Prompts:", and (worse, on a
    -- session's very first row) get picked as the session's first_real start
    -- marker.
    -- Detected here the same way is_command_echo is (a query-time heuristic
    -- on the raw prompt_text, not an ingest-side reclassification) since
    -- this is a display-time distinction, not a new calculated_type.
    startsWith(sr.prompt_text, '[tool_result]') AS is_tool_result_continuation,
    -- Bug fix: a resumed background subagent's next turn can be fed a
    -- relayed message FROM THE ORCHESTRATOR (SendMessage-style "the
    -- coordinator sent a message while you were working" injections), not
    -- anything the actual human typed. Confirmed against real
    -- agent_messages rows - the literal prefix is exact/stable (no trailing-
    -- space or colon variance observed across multiple sessions), always at
    -- position 0 of the raw prompt_text (never behind a stripped
    -- system-reminder first). Same query-time-heuristic pattern as
    -- is_command_echo/is_tool_result_continuation above - this isn't a
    -- Claude Code lifecycle convention _prompt_kind_and_display already
    -- recognizes, so it falls through to prompt_kind='real' and, left
    -- unchecked, renders with the real-user ❯ marker and counts toward
    -- "Prompts:"/first_real just like a genuine human message would.
    startsWith(sr.prompt_text, 'The coordinator sent a message while you were working:') AS is_coordinator_message,
    -- Best-effort preview of whatever text WAS attached alongside the
    -- tool_result block (so the row isn't just a bare, uninformative label):
    -- strip the literal "[tool_result]" marker, then strip a leading
    -- system-reminder wrapper if that's what follows (same tag this panel's
    -- own doc already documents stripping elsewhere, just re-anchored here
    -- since it may not sit at position 0 of the raw prompt_text - only of
    -- what's left after the marker), collapse whitespace runs (this whole
    -- panel renders inside a <pre>), then cap to a short preview length.
    -- Same 120-char convention already used for judge_reason/collaboration-
    -- mode/AskUserQuestion's nested grey lines.
    -- Collapsing whitespace BEFORE trimBoth (not after) matters: trimBoth
    -- only strips literal spaces, not newlines/tabs, so trimming first left
    -- a stray leading "\n" that the later whitespace-collapse turned into a
    -- visible leading space.
    substringUTF8(
      trimBoth(
        replaceRegexpAll(
          replaceRegexpOne(
            replaceOne(sr.prompt_text, '[tool_result]', ''),
            '(?s)^(?:\s*<system-reminder>.*?</system-reminder>)+\s*', ''
          ),
          '[ \t\n\r]+', ' '
        )
      ),
      1, 120
    ) AS tool_result_preview
  FROM scoped_events sr
  -- Bug fix (4th "Prompts:" inflation bug, see first_command_occurrence_ts's
  -- own comment above): prompt_kind='command' rows dedup on the clean
  -- (agent_invocation_id, command_name, display_text) key instead of raw
  -- prompt_text, since Codex's own self-resends of the same command carry a
  -- changing token-budget counter inside the raw text that defeats
  -- byte-exact dedup. Every other prompt_kind keeps the original byte-exact
  -- first_prompt_occurrence_ts dedup unchanged - those don't have this
  -- changing-counter problem, so there's no reason to loosen their dedup key.
  WHERE sr.prompt_text != '' AND sr.timestamp = if(
    JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'prompt_kind') = 'command',
    sr.first_command_occurrence_ts,
    sr.first_prompt_occurrence_ts
  )
),
prompt_final AS (
  SELECT session_id, ts, litellm_call_id, agent_invocation_id, is_agent_task,
    has_judge_ok, judge_ok, judge_reason, stop_hook_reason,
    prompt_kind = 'webpage_content' AS is_webpage,
    prompt_kind = 'suggestion_mode' AS is_sugg,
    prompt_kind = 'judge_call' AS is_judge,
    prompt_kind = 'stop_hook_feedback' AS is_stop_hook,
    prompt_kind = 'title_gen' AS is_title,
    -- ALLOWLIST (flipped from a denylist after 'away_recap' silently defaulted
    -- to real-user ❯ styling on arrival - a denylist means every future
    -- prompt_kind is real-user by default unless someone remembers to add it
    -- to an exclusion list, which is exactly what just happened). Only 'real'
    -- (a genuine freeform user prompt) and 'command' (an actual slash-command
    -- invocation) are user-authored input, PLUS 'interrupted' (a
    -- '[Request interrupted by user]'-prefixed prompt still carries real
    -- user-authored text once the prefix is stripped - see
    -- _prompt_kind_and_display's own docstring/branch - so it's genuine user
    -- input, not harness noise, despite the special prefix). Every other
    -- prompt_kind (system_notification, suggestion_mode, judge_call, title_gen,
    -- transcript_handoff, stop_hook_feedback, away_recap, webpage_content, and
    -- any future kind) now falls through to the muted ○ marker by default, with
    -- zero further list-maintenance required. webpage_content is deliberately
    -- NOT in this allowlist (it's tool output echoed back as a 'user'-role
    -- turn, not user-authored text) - this changes nothing visible since
    -- is_webpage already overrides the marker to ● ahead of is_real in the
    -- render chain below, and stats_prompts already excludes is_webpage rows
    -- from the count too.
    -- AND NOT is_command_echo: see is_command_echo's own comment above -
    -- excludes 'command'-kind rows that are actually a harness re-echo of an
    -- earlier command's own <command-args> tag (a <transcript>-wrapped
    -- severity check, or a "session is being continued" compaction summary),
    -- not a fresh human command submission.
    -- AND NOT is_tool_result_continuation: see is_tool_result_continuation's
    -- own comment above - a "[tool_result]"-prefixed prompt_text is an
    -- automatic API continuation (the previous turn's tool result, plus
    -- whatever Claude Code attached alongside it), never anything a human
    -- typed, regardless of which prompt_kind it happened to fall into.
    -- AND NOT is_coordinator_message: see is_coordinator_message's own
    -- comment above - a relayed orchestrator message fed into a resumed
    -- background subagent's next turn, never anything a human typed either.
    (prompt_kind IN ('real', 'command', 'interrupted') AND NOT is_command_echo AND NOT is_tool_result_continuation AND NOT is_coordinator_message) AS is_real,
    is_command_echo,
    is_tool_result_continuation,
    is_coordinator_message,
    if(is_tool_result_continuation,
      concat('[background] tool result continuation', if(tool_result_preview != '', concat(': ', tool_result_preview), '')),
      if(is_command_echo, '[background] resent context (harness echo of an earlier command)', display_text)
    ) AS display,
    -- display_arg, HTML-escaped the same way tool_render escapes its own
    -- raw_args -> escaped_args (a 90-char safety cap, then '&'/'<'/'>' only -
    -- no markdown/newline handling, since these values are short single-line
    -- facts like "2/100" or an agent-completion summary, not free-form
    -- prompt/reply text). Deliberately left at 90 (NOT bumped alongside
    -- tool_render's raw_args -> 110): this field renders on the tie=2
    -- prompt-marker line, which never appends the duration/tokens/cost
    -- stats column, so it isn't part of the single-line/last-line
    -- padding-before-stats system these two caps otherwise share elsewhere.
    -- Reused verbatim below inside the exact same
    -- <span style="opacity:.6">...</span> gray-argument markup tool_render
    -- already wraps its own escaped_args in, so these rows visually match
    -- tool-call rows: label/name in normal color, then a gray span for the
    -- variable part. Empty when display_arg is empty (the common case), so
    -- the row-rendering branch below can cheaply check != ''. Replaces the
    -- former tooltip_attr mechanism (a hover-only title="" attribute for
    -- transcript_handoff's severity-check verdict) - now redundant since
    -- display_arg already carries that same "block: yes/no" info as visible
    -- gray text.
    replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(
      substringUTF8(display_arg, 1, 90),
      '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>') AS display_arg_escaped
  FROM prompt_calc
),
stats_prompts AS (
  -- Only count genuine user-authored requests (the same is_real flag that
  -- drives the ❯ marker glyph below), excluding is_webpage (which overrides
  -- is_real's marker to ● even though is_real can be true for it) - anything
  -- else (sys-checks, title-gen, suggestion-mode, judge calls, transcript
  -- handoffs) is harness noise, not something the user asked for, and must
  -- not be lumped into "Prompts:". is_agent_task (a subagent's own spawn
  -- task, echoed back as its first "user"-role turn - see is_agent_task's
  -- own comment above) is likewise not user-authored and excluded here too.
  SELECT session_id AS session_id, countIf(is_real AND NOT is_webpage AND NOT is_agent_task) AS n_prompts
  FROM prompt_final
  GROUP BY session_id
),
session_stats AS (
  SELECT st.session_id AS session_id,
    concat(
      '<b>StartedAt:</b> ', formatDateTime(toTimeZone(sh.first_ts, '${__timezone}'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S'), '
',
      '<b>Duration:</b> ', if(st.dur_sec >= 3600, concat(toString(intDiv(st.dur_sec, 3600)), 'h ', toString(intDiv(st.dur_sec % 3600, 60)), 'm'), if(st.dur_sec >= 60, concat(toString(intDiv(st.dur_sec, 60)), 'm ', toString(st.dur_sec % 60), 's'), concat(toString(st.dur_sec), 's'))), '\n',
      '<b>Cost:</b> $', toString(round(coalesce(sk.cost_total, 0), 2)), '\n',
      '<b>Tokens:</b> ', multiIf(coalesce(sk.tok_in, 0) >= 1000000, concat(toString(round(coalesce(sk.tok_in, 0) / 1000000., 1)), 'm'), coalesce(sk.tok_in, 0) >= 1000, concat(toString(round(coalesce(sk.tok_in, 0) / 1000., 1)), 'k'), toString(coalesce(sk.tok_in, 0))), ' in / ', multiIf(coalesce(sk.tok_out, 0) >= 1000000, concat(toString(round(coalesce(sk.tok_out, 0) / 1000000., 1)), 'm'), coalesce(sk.tok_out, 0) >= 1000, concat(toString(round(coalesce(sk.tok_out, 0) / 1000., 1)), 'k'), toString(coalesce(sk.tok_out, 0))), ' out\n',
      '<b>Model(s):</b> ', coalesce(sk.models, ''), '\n',
      '<b>Prompts:</b> ', toString(coalesce(pr.n_prompts, 0)), '\n',
      '<b>Tool calls:</b> ', toString(st.n_tools), '\n',
      '<b>Agents:</b> ', if(coalesce(an.agents, '') = '', 'none', an.agents), '\n',
      '<b>Skills:</b> ', if(coalesce(sl.skills, '') = '', 'none', sl.skills), '\n',
      '<b>Git:</b> ', if(coalesce(sh.git_repo, '') = '' AND coalesce(sh.git_branch, '') = '', 'unknown', concat(if(sh.git_repo != '', sh.git_repo, '?'), ':', if(sh.git_branch != '', sh.git_branch, '?')))
    ) AS block
  FROM stats_time st
  LEFT JOIN stats_tokens sk ON sk.session_id = st.session_id
  LEFT JOIN stats_agent_names an ON an.session_id = st.session_id
  LEFT JOIN stats_skills sl ON sl.session_id = st.session_id
  LEFT JOIN stats_prompts pr ON pr.session_id = st.session_id
  LEFT JOIN session_header sh ON sh.session_id = st.session_id
),
tool_render AS (
  -- raw_args/escaped_args/full_args_attr now read from calculated_payload's
  -- precomputed 'tool_display_arg' key (computed once at ingest by
  -- _tool_display_arg in services/_common/src/ingest_parsing.py - the same file_path -> command
  -- -> sql -> url -> query -> description -> summary -> task_id -> raw-JSON
  -- -fallback preference chain this CTE used to run per dashboard row via an
  -- 8-branch JSONExtractString(args_json, ...) multiIf) instead of
  -- recomputing that preference chain on every load. _tool_display_arg does
  -- not itself truncate/collapse whitespace - all display-side truncation
  -- (the unified 110-char cap, bumped from 90 as part of the single-line/
  -- last-line stats-column alignment fix - see reply_render's own comment)
  -- and whitespace collapsing still happen here, unchanged from before,
  -- just against one already-selected value instead of
  -- 8 candidate JSON fields. AskUserQuestion is still special-cased to an
  -- empty preview: its args are a structured questions[] array, already
  -- fully rendered as its own nested grey lines (tie=4 below) - showing the
  -- raw/truncated JSON here too would be redundant and read as broken.
  -- full_args_attr mirrors escaped_args but WITHOUT the 110-char truncation,
  -- for use in a title="" tooltip showing the complete value on hover - it
  -- additionally escapes '"' to '"' since it sits inside an HTML
  -- attribute, not just element content.
  SELECT se.session_id AS session_id, se.litellm_call_id AS litellm_call_id,
    -- '[ \t\n\r]+' -> ' ' collapses literal newlines/carriage-returns too
    -- (not just spaces/tabs), not merely for cosmetic dedup - the whole
    -- panel renders inside a <pre> (literal whitespace preserved), so any
    -- raw '\n' in a multi-line argument (a multi-line Bash 'command' being
    -- the common case) would otherwise render as an actual visual line
    -- break in the middle of what must stay a single compact
    -- "├─ ToolName args" line.
    --
    -- raw_args is the same truncated preview BEFORE HTML-escaping - kept as
    -- its own column (not just an inline expression inside escaped_args)
    -- because column-padding math downstream must measure visual/rendered
    -- width, and escaping inflates character count without inflating
    -- rendered width: '>' -> '>' is 1 visible char but 4 string chars.
    -- Padding against escaped_args's length previously produced too few
    -- trailing spaces (and an inconsistent pad/no-pad threshold decision)
    -- for any arg containing '&'/'<'/'>' (shell redirects '2>', heredocs
    -- '<<', etc.) - see this panel's own doc for the full diagnosis.
    --
    -- ExitPlanMode is special-cased the same way as AskUserQuestion: its own
    -- args carry no useful preview text (only an optional, now-deprecated
    -- freeform allowedPrompts field), and the actual plan text - recovered
    -- separately via plan_proposals_match below - is far too large to show
    -- as an inline preview anyway (it's surfaced as a hover tooltip instead,
    -- via full_args_attr).
    if(se.tool_name IN ('AskUserQuestion', 'ExitPlanMode'), '',
      substringUTF8(replaceRegexpAll(JSONExtractString(se.calculated_payload, 'tool_display_arg'), '[ \t\n\r]+', ' '), 1, 110)
    ) AS raw_args,
    replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(raw_args, '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>') AS escaped_args,
    if(se.tool_name = 'AskUserQuestion', '',
      if(se.tool_name = 'ExitPlanMode',
        -- Full plan text (nearest-preceding plan_proposals row, matched via
        -- ASOF join - see plan_proposals_match) as an unbounded hover
        -- tooltip, same escaping (including '"' -> '"', since this
        -- sits inside an HTML attribute) as every other full_args_attr use.
        replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(
          coalesce(ppm.plan_text, ''),
          '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'),
        replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(
          replaceRegexpAll(JSONExtractString(se.calculated_payload, 'tool_display_arg'), '[ \t\n\r]+', ' '),
          '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"')
      )
    ) AS full_args_attr
  FROM scoped_events se
  LEFT JOIN plan_proposals_match ppm ON ppm.session_id = se.session_id AND ppm.litellm_call_id = se.litellm_call_id
  WHERE se.tool_name != '' AND se.tool_name != 'Agent' AND se.status != 'failure'
    AND se.calculated_type IN ('tool_call', 'skill_call')
),
-- Bug fix: reply/commentary text truncation used to be a flat
-- substringUTF8(...,1,1500) hard cut - it could (and did, per live repro)
-- land mid-word ("I'm investigatin") or mid-list-item ("2. Ch"), with no
-- visible sign anything was cut. Fixed to cut at the last whitespace
-- boundary before the 1500-char mark (dropping the trailing partial
-- word/line entirely) and to always append a visible '...' when
-- truncation actually happened - never when the text was already shorter
-- than the cap. Mirrors _truncate_at_word_boundary in
-- services/_common/src/ingest_parsing.py (see that function's own docstring) - keep both in
-- sync if either changes; that Python-side fix only affects newly-
-- ingested rows going forward; older already-ingested rows go through
-- THIS SQL-side copy every time the panel renders, so they get the fix
-- immediately without needing a reparse.
--
-- extractGroups(..., '(?s)^(.*)[ \t\n]')[1] greedily captures everything
-- up to the LAST whitespace char in the (already-1500-capped) string; RE2
-- has no backtracking but a greedy '.*' still resolves to the rightmost
-- valid match here, so this reliably finds the last space/tab/newline,
-- not the first. Falls back to a hard cut at 1500 (no '...' logic change,
-- still gets one) only when the capped text contains no whitespace at
-- all (one giant unbroken token) - group 1 is '' in that case since the
-- pattern can't match, so the `if(... != '', ...)` guard is required
-- (extractGroups on a non-matching pattern returns an array of empty
-- strings, not NULL).
--
-- This CTE is intentionally NOT scoped to tool_name = '' / status !=
-- 'failure' the way reply_render is (see below) - it's shared by BOTH
-- reply_render's own plain-reply branch (tool_name = '') and the separate
-- tie=3 "commentary" branch further below (tool_name != '', a call that
-- both replies AND calls a tool in the same response) - trimming the
-- WHERE here to reply_render's narrower filter would silently produce no
-- row at all for the commentary case's join.
reply_trunc AS (
  SELECT se.session_id AS session_id, se.litellm_call_id AS litellm_call_id,
    multiIf(
      lengthUTF8(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(se.response_text, '[ \t]+', ' '), '\n{2,}', '\n')) <= 1500,
      replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(se.response_text, '[ \t]+', ' '), '\n{2,}', '\n'),
      concat(
        trimRight(
          if(
            extractGroups(substringUTF8(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(se.response_text, '[ \t]+', ' '), '\n{2,}', '\n'), 1, 1500), '(?s)^(.*)[ \t\n]')[1] != '',
            extractGroups(substringUTF8(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(se.response_text, '[ \t]+', ' '), '\n{2,}', '\n'), 1, 1500), '(?s)^(.*)[ \t\n]')[1],
            substringUTF8(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(se.response_text, '[ \t]+', ' '), '\n{2,}', '\n'), 1, 1500)
          )
        ),
        '...'
      )
    ) AS trunc
  FROM scoped_events se
  WHERE trimBoth(coalesce(se.response_text, '')) != ''
),
-- Root-cause fix for reply-row misalignment: the tie=3 reply branch
-- (marked '● '/'└─ ● ') used to append a flat two-space gap before the
-- duration/tokens/cost stats regardless of how long its own text was -
-- unlike the tool-call/agent-spawn branches, which pad to a shared
-- ${trace_width_budget} column. That's why two reply rows of different
-- lengths landed their stats at wildly different horizontal positions.
--
-- styled_no_br precomputes, once per reply-bearing row, the FULLY
-- markdown-converted + HTML-escaped reply text (whitespace-collapsed,
-- truncated to 1500 chars, or to 120+'...' for a 'Web page content' dump
-- - see is_webpage) - everything the tie=3 display branch itself builds,
-- EXCEPT the final '\n' -> '<br>          ' wrap-indent conversion, which
-- the main query re-applies on top of this same value for display. This
-- is deliberately NOT the raw pre-markdown text: markdown's own
-- ```fenced code block``` -> inline-span conversion collapses multiple
-- raw lines (the fence delimiters and the newlines around them) into
-- fewer rendered ones, so a naive "split the RAW text on \n" approach
-- picks the wrong "last line" whenever a reply ends inside/after a code
-- fence (reproduced live: a reply ending in a ```bash ... ``` block's
-- raw last line is just the closing "```", not the code content that
-- actually renders last) - splitting the POST-markdown text avoids this
-- by construction, since by that point the fence's internal newlines are
-- already gone.
--
-- last_line_len / is_multiline implement this panel's general "single-
-- line/last-line" alignment rule: text that renders as ONE line is
-- padded using that whole line; text that wraps across multiple lines is
-- padded using only its LAST line, since earlier lines sit on their own
-- separate visual rows and never touch the stats column. The measured
-- length strips the markdown-added <b>/<span> tags (styling, no width)
-- and un-escapes '&'/'<'/'>' back to 1 char each (HTML entities
-- inflate character count without inflating rendered width - same rule
-- tool_render's raw_args/escaped_args split already established) before
-- calling lengthUTF8, so the padding target is the actual rendered width,
-- not the HTML source's character count.
reply_render AS (
  SELECT se.session_id AS session_id, se.litellm_call_id AS litellm_call_id,
    startsWith(se.response_text, 'Web page content') AS is_webpage,
    replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(
      if(startsWith(se.response_text, 'Web page content'),
        concat(substringUTF8(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(se.response_text, '[ \t]+', ' '), '\n{2,}', '\n'), 1, 120), '...'),
        rt.trunc
      ),
      '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'
    ), '\*\*([^*\n]+?)\*\*', '<b>\1</b>'), '(?s)```([a-zA-Z0-9+_-]*)\n(.*?)```', '<span style="color:#8ab8ff;font-weight:bold">\2</span>'), '`([^`\n]+?)`', '<span style="color:#8ab8ff;font-weight:bold">\1</span>'), '(?m)^(#{1,3}) (.*?)$', '<b>\2</b>') AS styled_no_br,
    position(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(
      if(startsWith(se.response_text, 'Web page content'),
        concat(substringUTF8(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(se.response_text, '[ \t]+', ' '), '\n{2,}', '\n'), 1, 120), '...'),
        rt.trunc
      ),
      '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'
    ), '\*\*([^*\n]+?)\*\*', '<b>\1</b>'), '(?s)```([a-zA-Z0-9+_-]*)\n(.*?)```', '<span style="color:#8ab8ff;font-weight:bold">\2</span>'), '`([^`\n]+?)`', '<span style="color:#8ab8ff;font-weight:bold">\1</span>'), '(?m)^(#{1,3}) (.*?)$', '<b>\2</b>'), '\n') > 0 AS is_multiline,
    lengthUTF8(
      replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(
        replaceRegexpAll(
          arrayElement(splitByChar('\n', replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(
      if(startsWith(se.response_text, 'Web page content'),
        concat(substringUTF8(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(se.response_text, '[ \t]+', ' '), '\n{2,}', '\n'), 1, 120), '...'),
        rt.trunc
      ),
      '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'
    ), '\*\*([^*\n]+?)\*\*', '<b>\1</b>'), '(?s)```([a-zA-Z0-9+_-]*)\n(.*?)```', '<span style="color:#8ab8ff;font-weight:bold">\2</span>'), '`([^`\n]+?)`', '<span style="color:#8ab8ff;font-weight:bold">\1</span>'), '(?m)^(#{1,3}) (.*?)$', '<b>\2</b>')), -1),
          '<[^>]+>', ''
        ),
        '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'
      )
    ) AS last_line_len
  FROM scoped_events se
  INNER JOIN reply_trunc rt ON rt.session_id = se.session_id AND rt.litellm_call_id = se.litellm_call_id
  WHERE se.tool_name = '' AND se.status != 'failure' AND trimBoth(coalesce(se.response_text, '')) != ''
),
-- A failed call's own error type (e.g. rate_limit_error) is now precomputed
-- once at ingest by _error_type in services/_common/src/ingest_parsing.py and stored directly on
-- the row's own calculated_payload under 'error_type' - no more JOIN to
-- ingest_raw (and its nested JSONExtractString(JSONExtractString(...,
-- 'error_information', 'error_message'), 'error', 'type') double-decode of the
-- full original payload) needed to recover it.
failure_error AS (
  SELECT sr.session_id AS session_id, sr.litellm_call_id AS litellm_call_id,
    JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'error_type') AS error_type
  FROM scoped_events sr
  WHERE sr.status = 'failure' AND sr.litellm_call_id != ''
),
tie2_ts AS (
  -- Every (session_id, litellm_call_id) that actually renders a tie=2
  -- prompt-marker line (i.e. survives that branch's own is_title/is_sugg
  -- filter) - used so the tie=3 branch (reply, and Agent-spawn/failure
  -- rows) can tell whether a visible timestamp was already shown on the
  -- marker line immediately above it in the tree (same underlying call),
  -- and suppress its own otherwise-duplicate timestamp rather than
  -- stacking two identical HH:MM:SS values on adjacent lines.
  SELECT DISTINCT pf.session_id AS session_id, pf.litellm_call_id AS litellm_call_id
  FROM prompt_final pf
  WHERE NOT pf.is_title AND NOT pf.is_sugg
),
first_real AS (
  -- Anything before the session's first genuine (non-harness) user message is
  -- pre-conversation noise (a silent auto-retry, a warm-up ping) invisible in
  -- the CLI itself - drop it rather than showing a confusing orphan FAIL row.
  -- Bug fix: is_real alone isn't enough here - a newly-spawned subagent's own
  -- first "user"-role turn (is_agent_task, the orchestrator's own task/prompt
  -- echoed back, not anything a human typed) still satisfies is_real's own
  -- prompt_kind check, so without this extra exclusion first_real's min(ts)
  -- could land on a background subagent's spawn-task timestamp instead of the
  -- session's actual first human message - reproduced live: the tree started
  -- mid-conversation at an assistant reply with no visible timestamp, because
  -- fr.ts had been pulled back to a subagent task-echo row that predated the
  -- real conversation. is_agent_task rows already render with their own '●'
  -- marker regardless (see is_agent_task's own comment above) - this only
  -- keeps them from ALSO acting as the session's start-of-trace cutoff.
  SELECT session_id, min(ts) AS ts
  FROM prompt_final
  WHERE is_real AND NOT is_agent_task
  GROUP BY session_id
)
SELECT session_id,
  arrayStringConcat(
    arrayMap(x -> x.4, arraySort(x -> (x.1, x.2, x.3), groupArray((sort_ts, tie, ts, line)))),
    '\n'
  ) AS tree
FROM (
  SELECT session_id, first_ts AS ts, first_ts AS sort_ts, 0 AS tie,
    concat('') AS line
  FROM session_header

  UNION ALL

  SELECT ss.session_id, sh.first_ts AS ts, sh.first_ts AS sort_ts, 1 AS tie,
    concat('\n', ss.block, '\n\n') AS line
  FROM session_stats ss
  INNER JOIN session_header sh ON sh.session_id = ss.session_id

  UNION ALL

  -- A subagent's own rows (prompt markers here, event lines below) sort by
  -- child_anchor's anchor_ts - the orchestrator's own spawn point - rather
  -- than their own real timestamp, so the whole block stays contiguous
  -- instead of interleaving with whatever the orchestrator did while the
  -- subagent was still running in the background. See child_anchor's own
  -- comment above for why.
  SELECT pf.session_id, pf.ts, if(pf.agent_invocation_id != '', coalesce(ca.anchor_ts, pf.ts), pf.ts) AS sort_ts, 2 AS tie,
    concat(
      -- The visible HH:MM:SS is just link text - the href carries this
      -- call's litellm_call_id (unique per call, confirmed) so the detail
      -- table below can match the exact agent_events row, replacing the
      -- old toString(pf.ts) value: two different rows sharing the same
      -- millisecond (parallel subagent dispatch, MCP bursts) would
      -- otherwise be ambiguous from a timestamp string alone, which
      -- litellm_call_id cannot be. A plain href replaces the *entire*
      -- query string on click (not just adds to it) - onclick+
      -- URLSearchParams.set() would merge instead, but Grafana's own HTML
      -- sanitizer (textUtil.sanitize(), on by default - see
      -- disableSanitizeHtml in grafana.ini) strips inline event handlers
      -- like onclick from Text-panel HTML, so that approach silently does
      -- nothing on click. Explicitly re-stating var-session_id (this row's
      -- own session, not whatever else was selected) alongside
      -- var-trace_ts keeps the session correct; the time range and active
      -- tab aren't preserved this way, but this panel's own query never
      -- filters by time range anyway.
      '<a href="/d/${__dashboard.uid}/agents-overview?var-session_id=', encodeURLComponent(pf.session_id), '&var-trace_ts=', encodeURLComponent(pf.litellm_call_id), '&dtab=Sessions-%26-Debugging&Sessions-%26-Debugging-dtab=Trace" style="color:inherit;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-style:dotted;">', formatDateTime(toTimeZone(pf.ts, '${__timezone}'), '%H:%i:%S'), '</a>', '  ',
      -- is_agent_task: a subagent's own spawn task, echoed back as its
      -- first "user"-role turn (see is_agent_task's own comment above) -
      -- authored by the orchestrator's model, not typed by a human. Unlike
      -- every other marker in this branch, is_agent_task ALWAYS renders as
      -- a bare bullet with no indent and no tree connector (└─/├─),
      -- regardless of whether the echoed task text is present or
      -- empty/blank - this row is never nested visually under anything,
      -- so an indent+connector prefix here would misleadingly imply
      -- parentage that doesn't exist for this node.
      if(pf.is_agent_task,
        '● ',
        concat(
          if(pf.agent_invocation_id != '', '   ', ''),
          -- judge_call now shares the same hollow-circle ○ marker used for
          -- every other background/harness row (system_notification,
          -- transcript_handoff, ...) - it used to get its own 🧐 emoji, but
          -- the verdict itself is now surfaced via a 👍/👎 to the right of
          -- the row instead (see below), so a distinct marker glyph is no
          -- longer needed here.
          if(pf.is_webpage, '● ', if(pf.is_real, '<span style="color:#e0af02">❯</span> ', '○ '))
        )
      ),
      -- Render display_text (normal color, with the usual markdown/newline/
      -- slash-command conversions) as before, then append display_arg_escaped
      -- (when non-empty) wrapped in the SAME gray-span markup tool_render
      -- already uses for its own args after a tool name
      -- (<span style="opacity:.6">...</span>) - visually unifying these rows
      -- with tool-call rows: label/name, then a gray span for the variable
      -- part. When display_arg_escaped is empty (the common case for most
      -- prompt_kind rows), this renders exactly as before with no added span.
      concat(
        replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(pf.display, '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '\*\*([^*\n]+?)\*\*', '<b>\1</b>'), '(?s)```([a-zA-Z0-9+_-]*)\n(.*?)```', '<span style="color:#8ab8ff;font-weight:bold">\2</span>'), '`([^`\n]+?)`', '<span style="color:#8ab8ff;font-weight:bold">\1</span>'), '(?m)^(#{1,3}) (.*?)$', '<b>\2</b>'), '\n', '<br>          '), '(^|\s)(/[a-zA-Z][\w-]*)', '\1<span style="color:#8ab8ff;font-weight:bold">\2</span>'), '<span style="color:#8ab8ff;font-weight:bold">(/[a-zA-Z][\w-]*)</span>(/)', '\1\2'),
        if(pf.display_arg_escaped != '', concat('  <span style="opacity:.6">', pf.display_arg_escaped, '</span>'), ''),
        -- judge_ok's verdict, shown as a thumbs-up/down to the right of the
        -- row: 👍 when the judge call's own precomputed judge_ok is true,
        -- 👎 when false, and nothing at all when the key is absent
        -- (has_judge_ok = false - older un-reparsed rows predate this
        -- field, so don't guess a verdict for them).
        if(pf.is_judge AND pf.has_judge_ok, concat(' ', if(pf.judge_ok, '👍', '👎')), '')
      )
    ) AS line
  FROM prompt_final pf
  INNER JOIN first_real fr ON fr.session_id = pf.session_id
  LEFT JOIN child_anchor ca ON ca.session_id = pf.session_id AND ca.agent_id = pf.agent_invocation_id
  WHERE pf.ts >= fr.ts AND NOT pf.is_title AND NOT pf.is_sugg

  UNION ALL

  -- judge_reason rendered as a nested grey line beneath its own judge_call
  -- row - same "hollow circle, gray text" convention already used for
  -- AskUserQuestion's questions[] sub-items below (tie=4, same row's own
  -- ts/sort_ts as its parent so it sorts immediately after it; reusing
  -- tie=4 rather than inventing a new tie value keeps this within the same
  -- "auxiliary subtree line" family AskUserQuestion already established).
  -- Skipped entirely when judge_reason is absent/empty (older un-reparsed
  -- rows, or - in principle - a judge call whose reasoning wasn't
  -- captured), rather than rendering an empty sub-row.
  SELECT pf.session_id, pf.ts, if(pf.agent_invocation_id != '', coalesce(ca.anchor_ts, pf.ts), pf.ts) AS sort_ts, 4 AS tie,
    concat(
      '<a href="/d/${__dashboard.uid}/agents-overview?var-session_id=', encodeURLComponent(pf.session_id), '&var-trace_ts=', encodeURLComponent(pf.litellm_call_id), '&dtab=Sessions-%26-Debugging&Sessions-%26-Debugging-dtab=Trace" style="opacity:0">', formatDateTime(toTimeZone(pf.ts, '${__timezone}'), '%H:%i:%S'), '</a>', '  ',
      if(pf.agent_invocation_id != '', '   ', ''),
      '○ ',
      '<span style="opacity:.6">',
      replaceRegexpAll(
        substringUTF8(replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(pf.judge_reason, '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), 1, 120),
        '\n', '<br>          '),
      if(lengthUTF8(pf.judge_reason) > 120, '...', ''),
      '</span>'
    ) AS line
  FROM prompt_final pf
  INNER JOIN first_real fr ON fr.session_id = pf.session_id
  LEFT JOIN child_anchor ca ON ca.session_id = pf.session_id AND ca.agent_id = pf.agent_invocation_id
  WHERE pf.ts >= fr.ts AND pf.is_judge AND pf.judge_reason != ''

  UNION ALL

  -- stop_hook_reason rendered as a nested grey line beneath its own
  -- stop_hook_feedback row - same "hollow circle, gray text" convention as
  -- judge_reason above, but shown in FULL with no character-length
  -- truncation (the user explicitly asked this not be abbreviated, unlike
  -- every other capped field in this panel). Literal newlines (rare in
  -- practice for this field, but not guaranteed absent) are still converted
  -- to <br> the same way prompt/reply text is elsewhere, since this whole
  -- panel renders inside a <pre> where a raw '\n' would otherwise break the
  -- line layout. Skipped entirely when stop_hook_reason is absent/empty.
  SELECT pf.session_id, pf.ts, if(pf.agent_invocation_id != '', coalesce(ca.anchor_ts, pf.ts), pf.ts) AS sort_ts, 4 AS tie,
    concat(
      '<a href="/d/${__dashboard.uid}/agents-overview?var-session_id=', encodeURLComponent(pf.session_id), '&var-trace_ts=', encodeURLComponent(pf.litellm_call_id), '&dtab=Sessions-%26-Debugging&Sessions-%26-Debugging-dtab=Trace" style="opacity:0">', formatDateTime(toTimeZone(pf.ts, '${__timezone}'), '%H:%i:%S'), '</a>', '  ',
      if(pf.agent_invocation_id != '', '   ', ''),
      '○ ',
      '<span style="opacity:.6">',
      replaceRegexpAll(
        replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(pf.stop_hook_reason, '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'),
        '\n', '<br>          '),
      '</span>'
    ) AS line
  FROM prompt_final pf
  INNER JOIN first_real fr ON fr.session_id = pf.session_id
  LEFT JOIN child_anchor ca ON ca.session_id = pf.session_id AND ca.agent_id = pf.agent_invocation_id
  WHERE pf.ts >= fr.ts AND pf.is_stop_hook AND pf.stop_hook_reason != ''

  UNION ALL
