  SELECT sr.session_id, sr.timestamp AS ts, if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', coalesce(ca.anchor_ts, sr.timestamp), sr.timestamp) AS sort_ts, 3 AS tie,
    concat(
      -- Bug fix: a single LLM call can emit BOTH a text/commentary block AND
      -- a tool_use block in the same response - agent_events.tool_name
      -- reflects only the tool that was called, while
      -- agent_messages.response_text (joined via litellm_call_id) can
      -- independently be non-empty for that same call. The reply-rendering
      -- branch below only fires when tool_name = '', so that commentary used
      -- to be silently dropped with no trace at all whenever a tool was also
      -- called. Render it here as its own "● <text>" line (same
      -- escaping/markdown/newline-conversion/1500-char-cap treatment as the
      -- plain-reply branch) ahead of whatever follows (failed_tool_name
      -- error note, then the tool-call/agent-spawn/reply line itself) - an
      -- invisible (opacity:0) timestamp link, same pattern as the
      -- failed_tool_name block below, since the following block already
      -- carries its own visible timestamp link for this same row.
      if(sr.tool_name != '' AND trimBoth(coalesce(sr.response_text, '')) != '',
        concat(
          '<a href="/d/${__dashboard.uid}/agents-overview?var-session_id=', encodeURLComponent(sr.session_id), '&var-trace_ts=', encodeURLComponent(sr.litellm_call_id), '&dtab=Sessions-%26-Debugging&Sessions-%26-Debugging-dtab=Trace" style="opacity:0">', formatDateTime(toTimeZone(sr.timestamp, '${__timezone}'), '%H:%i:%S'), '</a>', '  ',
          if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', '   ', ''),
          '● ',
          replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(
            rtc.trunc,
            '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'
          ), '\*\*([^*\n]+?)\*\*', '<b>\1</b>'), '(?s)```([a-zA-Z0-9+_-]*)\n(.*?)```', '<span style="color:#8ab8ff;font-weight:bold">\2</span>'), '`([^`\n]+?)`', '<span style="color:#8ab8ff;font-weight:bold">\1</span>'), '(?m)^(#{1,3}) (.*?)$', '<b>\2</b>'), '\n', '<br>          '),
          '<br>'
        ),
        ''
      ),
      if(sr.failed_tool_name != '',
        concat(
          '<a href="/d/${__dashboard.uid}/agents-overview?var-session_id=', encodeURLComponent(sr.session_id), '&var-trace_ts=', encodeURLComponent(sr.litellm_call_id), '&dtab=Sessions-%26-Debugging&Sessions-%26-Debugging-dtab=Trace" style="opacity:0">', formatDateTime(toTimeZone(sr.timestamp, '${__timezone}'), '%H:%i:%S'), '</a>', '     🚨 ',
          replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(sr.failed_tool_name, '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'),
          ' failed: <span style="opacity:.6">',
          replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(
            -- Collapse ALL whitespace runs (including single newlines/tabs/
            -- CR), not just runs of 2+ newlines - this whole panel renders
            -- inside a <pre> (literal whitespace preserved), so a single
            -- '\n' in the error text (common in multi-line rejection
            -- messages) would otherwise break this line into multiple
            -- visual lines and run straight into whatever follows with no
            -- separator. Same collapsing principle already used for
            -- tool_render's raw_args.
            -- Bug fix: this is tool ERROR output (the 🚨-marked branch,
            -- failed_tool_name != '') - per explicit user request, error text
            -- must never be length-truncated, only newline-collapsed (as
            -- above, unchanged/"as-is"). A 200-char cap here previously cut
            -- real error messages mid-sentence (e.g. "🚨 Read failed: File
            -- content (423..." with no way to see what actually failed) -
            -- removed the substringUTF8(...,1,200) wrapper entirely; the
            -- collapse-whitespace regex is the only transformation left.
            replaceRegexpAll(sr.failed_tool_error, '[ \t\n\r]+', ' '),
            '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'),
          '</span>',
          -- The next block (reply/tool-call/agent-spawn/API-error) is always
          -- non-empty (a bare "● " marker at minimum, or "├─ ToolName" etc),
          -- so whenever failed_tool_name is set the two blocks always
          -- concatenate directly with no separator - a model turn that BOTH
          -- calls a secondary tool that got rejected (failed_tool_name) AND
          -- successfully calls its main tool (Bash/Read/etc, tool_name !=
          -- '') in the same response renders both in this exact row, and
          -- without a break here the tail of the (already collapsed to one
          -- line) error text runs straight into the next block's own
          -- (invisible) timestamp link and tool-call text with zero
          -- whitespace between them. Unlike the '<br>          ' (newline +
          -- 10sp indent) convention used for wrapped CONTINUATION lines
          -- within a single row (reply/prompt text), what follows here is a
          -- full separate top-level tree entry (its own tool-call/reply/
          -- agent-spawn line), which must render flush-left at column 0 like
          -- any other top-level tie=3 row - so just a bare line break, no
          -- indent spaces.
          '<br>'
        ),
        ''
      ),
      -- Reply rows show the model's full text (can wrap across lines in the
      -- viewer), so unlike a bounded tool-call argument the text itself is
      -- never truncated down to the shared width budget - but the trailing
      -- gap before the stats column IS now padded like every other branch,
      -- keyed off rr.last_line_len (the rendered length of the LAST line of
      -- the exact same markdown-converted text this branch displays, via
      -- rr.styled_no_br - see reply_render's own comment for why the raw
      -- pre-markdown text can't be used for this and why only the LAST
      -- line matters for a wrapped/multi-line reply). This used to be a
      -- flat two-space gap regardless of text length, which is why two
      -- reply rows of different lengths landed their stats at very
      -- different horizontal positions - the root cause of the reported
      -- misalignment. If a tie=2 marker line was already shown immediately
      -- above for this exact call (the reply's own prompt, e.g. an
      -- is_sys/background-check or is_transcript_handoff row), suppress
      -- this reply's own timestamp (invisible link, same rendered width)
      -- instead of stacking an identical HH:MM:SS on both lines.
      if(sr.tool_name = '' AND sr.status != 'failure',
        concat(
          if(t2.litellm_call_id IS NOT NULL,
            concat('<a href="/d/${__dashboard.uid}/agents-overview?var-session_id=', encodeURLComponent(sr.session_id), '&var-trace_ts=', encodeURLComponent(sr.litellm_call_id), '&dtab=Sessions-%26-Debugging&Sessions-%26-Debugging-dtab=Trace" style="opacity:0">', formatDateTime(toTimeZone(sr.timestamp, '${__timezone}'), '%H:%i:%S'), '</a>'),
            concat('<a href="/d/${__dashboard.uid}/agents-overview?var-session_id=', encodeURLComponent(sr.session_id), '&var-trace_ts=', encodeURLComponent(sr.litellm_call_id), '&dtab=Sessions-%26-Debugging&Sessions-%26-Debugging-dtab=Trace" style="color:inherit;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-style:dotted;">', formatDateTime(toTimeZone(sr.timestamp, '${__timezone}'), '%H:%i:%S'), '</a>')
          ), '  ',
          -- If the model's reply text is itself empty/blank (nothing to
          -- attach the tree connector to), drop the indent AND the └─
          -- connector entirely and render just the bare bullet, instead of
          -- padding out to the stats column with an indent+connector and no
          -- visible text after it (or the old '[empty reply]' placeholder,
          -- now removed - the bare bullet communicates "empty" on its own).
          if(trimBoth(coalesce(sr.response_text, '')) = '',
            concat('● ', '  '),
            concat(
              if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', '   ', ''),
              if(rr.is_webpage, '   └─ ● ', '└─ ● '),
              -- rr.styled_no_br is the already markdown-converted/escaped
              -- text (see reply_render) - only the final '\n' -> '<br>
              -- (10sp)' wrap-indent conversion happens here, reused
              -- identically for both display and (via last_line_len,
              -- computed the same way inside reply_render) padding.
              replaceRegexpAll(rr.styled_no_br, '\n', '<br>          '),
              -- Padding formula mirrors the tool-call/agent-spawn branches
              -- (only pad when content already fits - never truncate after
              -- the fact), applied to rr.last_line_len. A multi-line
              -- reply's last line sits on its own continuation row (after
              -- the flat 10-space '<br>          ' indent, never adjusted
              -- for nesting), which starts at column 0, NOT after the
              -- marker prefix - so unlike the single-line case, the target
              -- here is the bare ${trace_width_budget} with NO extra '10 +'
              -- added to last_line_len. The stats column must land at the
              -- same absolute screen column as a single-line row's: a
              -- single-line row's own leading timestamp+'  ' (10 visible
              -- chars) sits OUTSIDE its padded target, so its stats end up
              -- at column 10 + target. A wrapped continuation line's own
              -- 10-space indent plays the exact same role - it's already
              -- physically present before last_line_len on that line - so
              -- adding another '10 +' inside the pad computation double-
              -- counts that same 10 columns and the padding formula ends up
              -- subtracting it once too often, undershooting the target by
              -- exactly 10 columns (reproduced live: every multi-line
              -- reply's trailing stats landed one full '10' short of every
              -- single-line row's). The fix: pad using bare
              -- ${trace_width_budget} - rr.last_line_len (no '10 +' on
              -- either side) - the already-present 10-space indent plus
              -- last_line_len plus this pad sums to 10 + budget, matching
              -- single-line rows' 10 + budget exactly, regardless of
              -- nesting (continuation-line indent is flat, never nesting-
              -- adjusted, hence no '- 3' here either - same as before).
              if(rr.is_multiline,
                if(rr.last_line_len < ${trace_width_budget},
                  repeat(' ', ${trace_width_budget} - rr.last_line_len),
                  '  '
                ),
                if(lengthUTF8(if(rr.is_webpage, '   └─ ● ', '└─ ● ')) + rr.last_line_len < if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', (${trace_width_budget} - 3), ${trace_width_budget}),
                  repeat(' ', if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', (${trace_width_budget} - 3), ${trace_width_budget}) - (lengthUTF8(if(rr.is_webpage, '   └─ ● ', '└─ ● ')) + rr.last_line_len)),
                  '  '
                )
              )
            )
          )
        ),
        if(sr.tool_name != '' AND sr.tool_name != 'Agent' AND sr.status != 'failure',
          -- Real tool call: a short fixed gap (not a wide fixed-width pad)
          -- between the args text and the stats block - a large pad width
          -- left a huge gap after short args (e.g. "Bash cat Makefile")
          -- and, before this, also risked truncating long args and
          -- silently breaking the replaceOne() span-wrap below (see the
          -- padding-vs-truncation gotcha in this agent's own doc).
          -- Column alignment: pad only the "├─ ToolName args" portion (not
          -- the leading timestamp/indent, which is now a real, if invisible,
          -- <a> link so the row is clickable like every other row - padding
          -- would otherwise measure the link's raw HTML length instead of
          -- its rendered visual width and silently stop aligning anything).
          concat(
            '<a href="/d/${__dashboard.uid}/agents-overview?var-session_id=', encodeURLComponent(sr.session_id), '&var-trace_ts=', encodeURLComponent(sr.litellm_call_id), '&dtab=Sessions-%26-Debugging&Sessions-%26-Debugging-dtab=Trace" style="opacity:0">', formatDateTime(toTimeZone(sr.timestamp, '${__timezone}'), '%H:%i:%S'), '</a>', '  ',
            if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', '   ', ''),
            if(tr.escaped_args != '',
              -- Pad using tr.raw_args's PRE-ESCAPE length, not
              -- tr.escaped_args's - HTML-escaping expands '&'/'<'/'>' into
              -- multi-char entities ('>' etc.) that inflate the escaped
              -- string's character count without inflating its rendered
              -- width in the browser (a single '>' still renders as one
              -- '>' glyph). Padding/threshold math against the escaped
              -- string therefore under-padded any row whose args contained
              -- a shell redirect ('2>'), heredoc ('<<'), etc., pulling that
              -- row's duration/tokens/cost columns to the left relative to
              -- rows with no such characters - see this panel's own doc for
              -- the full diagnosis/repro. Only pad when the unpadded
              -- content already fits within the target width - beyond that,
              -- literal spaces are simply skipped (not truncated), which is
              -- what keeps the replaceOne() substring match below 100%
              -- reliable (rightPadUTF8 used to silently truncate mid-span
              -- when its input already exceeded the requested length,
              -- chopping straight through tr.escaped_args and leaving the
              -- argument text unwrapped - reproduced live with long
              -- file_path values, back when that field alone was allowed up
              -- to 120 chars against a 90-char pad width; every field cap is
              -- now unified to 110 (bumped from 90 as part of the single-
              -- line/last-line stats-column alignment fix - see
              -- reply_render's own comment), and the pad width itself now
              -- comes from ${trace_width_budget} (117/120), see below). Padding itself is now literal spaces
              -- appended via repeat() to the already-built HTML (which
              -- still contains tr.escaped_args), rather than rightPadUTF8
              -- padding the HTML string directly - that was the other half
              -- of the same bug, since rightPadUTF8 was also being asked to
              -- measure width against escaped (entity-inflated) content.
              multiIf(
                lengthUTF8(concat('├─ ', if(lower(sr.tool_name) = 'web_search', 'WebSearch', sr.tool_name), ' ', tr.raw_args)) < if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', (${trace_width_budget} - 3), ${trace_width_budget}),
                concat(
                  replaceOne(
                    concat('├─ ', if(lower(sr.tool_name) = 'web_search', 'WebSearch', sr.tool_name), ' ', tr.escaped_args),
                    tr.escaped_args,
                    concat('<span style="opacity:.6" title="', tr.full_args_attr, '">', tr.escaped_args, '</span>')
                  ),
                  repeat(' ', greatest(0, if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', (${trace_width_budget} - 3), ${trace_width_budget}) - lengthUTF8(concat('├─ ', if(lower(sr.tool_name) = 'web_search', 'WebSearch', sr.tool_name), ' ', tr.raw_args))))
                ),
                replaceOne(
                  concat('├─ ', if(lower(sr.tool_name) = 'web_search', 'WebSearch', sr.tool_name), ' ', tr.escaped_args),
                  tr.escaped_args,
                  concat('<span style="opacity:.6" title="', tr.full_args_attr, '">', tr.escaped_args, '</span>')
                )
              ),
              -- Args are empty (AskUserQuestion/ExitPlanMode - see
              -- tool_render) but full_args_attr may still carry a tooltip
              -- (ExitPlanMode's plan text, via plan_proposals_match) - wrap
              -- just the tool-name text in a title="" span so it's still
              -- hoverable even with nothing visible after it. Padding is
              -- still measured against the plain (untagged) tool-name text,
              -- never the wrapped HTML, for the same reason as everywhere
              -- else in this branch: tags inflate character count without
              -- inflating rendered width.
              if(tr.full_args_attr != '',
                concat(
                  '<span title="', tr.full_args_attr, '">├─ ', if(lower(sr.tool_name) = 'web_search', 'WebSearch', sr.tool_name), '</span>',
                  repeat(' ', greatest(0, if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', (${trace_width_budget} - 3), ${trace_width_budget}) - lengthUTF8(concat('├─ ', if(lower(sr.tool_name) = 'web_search', 'WebSearch', sr.tool_name)))))
                ),
                rightPadUTF8(
                  concat('├─ ', if(lower(sr.tool_name) = 'web_search', 'WebSearch', sr.tool_name)),
                  if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', (${trace_width_budget} - 3), ${trace_width_budget}), ' ')
              )
            )
          ),
          concat(
            if(t2.litellm_call_id IS NOT NULL,
              concat('<a href="/d/${__dashboard.uid}/agents-overview?var-session_id=', encodeURLComponent(sr.session_id), '&var-trace_ts=', encodeURLComponent(sr.litellm_call_id), '&dtab=Sessions-%26-Debugging&Sessions-%26-Debugging-dtab=Trace" style="opacity:0">', formatDateTime(toTimeZone(sr.timestamp, '${__timezone}'), '%H:%i:%S'), '</a>'),
              concat('<a href="/d/${__dashboard.uid}/agents-overview?var-session_id=', encodeURLComponent(sr.session_id), '&var-trace_ts=', encodeURLComponent(sr.litellm_call_id), '&dtab=Sessions-%26-Debugging&Sessions-%26-Debugging-dtab=Trace" style="color:inherit;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-style:dotted;">', formatDateTime(toTimeZone(sr.timestamp, '${__timezone}'), '%H:%i:%S'), '</a>')
            ), '  ',
            if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', '   ', ''),
            '├─ ',
            -- Same total-width column budget as the regular tool-call branch
            -- above (${trace_width_budget} chars top-level, ${trace_width_budget} - 3
            -- nested - the 3-char indent eats INTO the shared total rather
            -- than being added on top of a flat content width, so nested
            -- rows' stats land in the same column as top-level rows' stats;
            -- see this panel's own doc for the "indent eats from the width
            -- budget" gotcha). trace_width_budget is a single hidden
            -- dashboard TextVariable (default 120) referenced unquoted here
            -- and in every other branch that shares this budget - see this
            -- panel's own doc, "Width budget as a dashboard variable"
            -- section, for why a Grafana variable (not a CTE constant) was
            -- used. This branch previously appended a flat '          ' (10
            -- spaces) regardless of content length, which is exactly why
            -- Agent-spawn rows (and same-branch tool-failure rows) never
            -- lined up with the formula-padded tool-call rows around them -
            -- a flat pad can't compensate for a description field that used
            -- to render fully unbounded. The description is pre-truncated
            -- (70 chars, bumped from 50 as part of the single-line/last-line
            -- stats-column alignment fix - see reply_render's own comment -
            -- but still deliberately NOT unified to the 110-char tool-arg
            -- cap, since this field isn't one of the tool_render argument
            -- branches the unification applies to) before padding, same
            -- "truncate first" safety rule used for tool-call args
            -- (tool_render's raw_args) so the pad-length computation is
            -- always a true upper bound on rendered width.
            if(sr.status = 'failure',
              concat('🚨 API error: <span style="opacity:.6">',
                replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(
                  if(coalesce(fe.error_type, '') != '', fe.error_type, 'unknown'),
                  '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'),
                '</span>'
              ),
              concat(
                'Agent spawned: <b>',
                -- agent_display_name (subagent_type.split('_')[0], defaulting
                -- to '?' when subagent_type is blank) is precomputed once at
                -- ingest by _classify_event's agent_spawn branch and stored
                -- directly on this same row's own calculated_payload - no more
                -- splitByChar('_', ...)[1] re-derivation here, and (as before)
                -- no ASOF join into agent_invocations on nearest spawned_at,
                -- since the data already lives on the row being rendered.
                replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(
                  JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'agent_display_name'),
                  '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'),
                '</b>',
                -- description is now capped at 70 chars (was unbounded, then
                -- 50) so this row's rendered width is bounded and can
                -- actually be padded to the shared column budget below - see
                -- comment above.
                if(JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'description') != '',
                  concat(' <span style="opacity:.6" title="',
                    replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(
                      JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'description'),
                      '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'),
                    '">',
                    replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(
                      substringUTF8(replaceRegexpAll(JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'description'), '[ \t\n\r]+', ' '), 1, 70),
                      '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'),
                    '</span>'
                  ), ''
                )
              )
            ),
            if(sr.status = 'failure', ' [FAIL]', ''),
            -- Pad using RAW (unescaped, pre-truncated) content length, not
            -- the escaped/HTML-tagged length above - same reasoning as
            -- tool_render's raw_args vs escaped_args: HTML entities and
            -- <b>/<span> tags inflate character count without inflating
            -- rendered width. Only pad when it already fits the target
            -- width; beyond that, spaces are simply skipped (never
            -- truncated after the fact), matching the tool-call branch.
            if(
              lengthUTF8(concat('├─ ',
                if(sr.status = 'failure',
                  concat('🚨 API error: ', if(coalesce(fe.error_type, '') != '', fe.error_type, 'unknown')),
                  concat('Agent spawned: ',
                    JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'agent_display_name'),
                    if(JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'description') != '',
                      concat(' ', substringUTF8(replaceRegexpAll(JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'description'), '[ \t\n\r]+', ' '), 1, 70)),
                      ''
                    )
                  )
                ),
                if(sr.status = 'failure', ' [FAIL]', '')
              )) < if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', (${trace_width_budget} - 3), ${trace_width_budget}),
              repeat(' ', if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', (${trace_width_budget} - 3), ${trace_width_budget}) - lengthUTF8(concat('├─ ',
                if(sr.status = 'failure',
                  concat('🚨 API error: ', if(coalesce(fe.error_type, '') != '', fe.error_type, 'unknown')),
                  concat('Agent spawned: ',
                    JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'agent_display_name'),
                    if(JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'description') != '',
                      concat(' ', substringUTF8(replaceRegexpAll(JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'description'), '[ \t\n\r]+', ' '), 1, 70)),
                      ''
                    )
                  )
                ),
                if(sr.status = 'failure', ' [FAIL]', '')
              ))),
              '  '
            )
          )
        )
      ),
      '<span style="opacity:.5">', leftPad(if(sr.latency_ms IS NOT NULL, if(sr.latency_ms > 100, concat(toString(round(sr.latency_ms / 1000., 1)), 's'), concat(toString(sr.latency_ms), 'ms')), ''), 7, ' '), '</span>',
      '<span style="opacity:.6">', leftPad(if(u.tok > 0, multiIf(u.tok >= 1000000, concat(toString(round(u.tok / 1000000., 1)), 'm'), u.tok >= 1000, concat(toString(round(u.tok / 1000., 1)), 'k'), toString(u.tok)), ''), 9, ' '), '</span>',
      '<span style="opacity:.7">', if(u.cost > 0, concat('   $', toString(round(u.cost, 2))), ''), '</span>'
    ) AS line
  FROM scoped_events sr
  INNER JOIN first_real fr ON fr.session_id = sr.session_id
  LEFT JOIN usage_by_call u ON u.session_id = sr.session_id AND sr.litellm_call_id != '' AND u.litellm_call_id = sr.litellm_call_id
  LEFT JOIN tool_render tr ON tr.session_id = sr.session_id AND sr.litellm_call_id != '' AND tr.litellm_call_id = sr.litellm_call_id
  LEFT JOIN reply_render rr ON rr.session_id = sr.session_id AND sr.litellm_call_id != '' AND rr.litellm_call_id = sr.litellm_call_id
  -- Separate alias (rtc, not rr/reply_trunc's own rt) because the tie=3
  -- "commentary" branch above fires for tool_name != '' rows, which
  -- reply_render's own WHERE (tool_name = '') never produces a row for -
  -- see reply_trunc's own comment for why this join can't just reuse rr.
  LEFT JOIN reply_trunc rtc ON rtc.session_id = sr.session_id AND sr.litellm_call_id != '' AND rtc.litellm_call_id = sr.litellm_call_id
  LEFT JOIN child_anchor ca ON ca.session_id = sr.session_id AND ca.agent_id = sr.agent_invocation_id
  LEFT JOIN failure_error fe ON fe.session_id = sr.session_id AND sr.litellm_call_id != '' AND fe.litellm_call_id = sr.litellm_call_id
  LEFT JOIN tie2_ts t2 ON t2.session_id = sr.session_id AND sr.litellm_call_id != '' AND t2.litellm_call_id = sr.litellm_call_id
  -- Suggestion-mode/title-gen/transcript-handoff rows are hidden entirely
  -- from tie=3 (their own reply text is harness-noise output, not a real
  -- answer to a real question) - is_sugg/is_title/is_transcript_handoff used
  -- to be recomputed here via the reply_flags CTE (a separate startsWith(
  -- prompt_text, ...) re-derivation, joined on the old x.timestamp =
  -- ev.timestamp pattern); both the join and the re-derivation are gone now
  -- that calculated_type already carries this same classification directly
  -- on sr itself (computed once, from this exact row's own prompt_text, at
  -- ingest).
  -- A successful judge_call's own raw reply row is ALSO hidden from tie=3 -
  -- its reply text is now shown, cleanly formatted/truncated, via the
  -- dedicated tie=4 judge_reason row below, so the raw unstyled
  -- '{"ok":..., "reason":...}' JSON this branch would otherwise render is
  -- redundant. Deliberately scoped to status != 'failure' only: a judge_call
  -- whose own LLM request failed has no judge_ok/judge_reason to show via
  -- tie=4 (calculated_type is still 'judge_call' even on failure, since
  -- _classify_event only inspects the outgoing prompt, not the response) -
  -- that failure's own '🚨 API error' line must still render here, or a
  -- failed judge call would silently vanish from the trace entirely.
  WHERE sr.timestamp >= fr.ts AND sr.calculated_type NOT IN ('suggestion_mode', 'title_gen', 'transcript_handoff')
    AND NOT (sr.calculated_type = 'judge_call' AND sr.status != 'failure')
    AND NOT (sr.tool_name = '' AND sr.status != 'failure' AND JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'prompt_kind') = 'stop_hook_feedback')

  UNION ALL

  -- Codex CLI collaboration-mode change marker: precomputed at ingest onto
  -- calculated_payload's own 'collaboration_mode_change' key (set only on
  -- the specific row where Codex switched its internal collaboration mode,
  -- detected from an injected role="developer" message - see
  -- services/_common/src/ingest_parsing.py). Rendered as its own hollow-circle, grey-text
  -- line - the SAME "system/harness noise" visual convention (hollow
  -- circle, opacity:.6 span) already used above for judge_reason/
  -- stop_hook_reason/AskUserQuestion's questions[] - deliberately NOT the
  -- filled reply marker (bullet) or the real-user marker (arrow), since a
  -- collaboration-mode switch/starting-mode announcement is harness/system
  -- bookkeeping, not something the user typed or the model said.
  --
  -- Ordering: unlike those other tie=4 auxiliary lines (which are genuinely
  -- subordinate to their own row's prompt/reply text and belong AFTER it),
  -- this marker must sort BEFORE its own row's prompt line (tie=2) - both
  -- for the "starting mode" case (fires on a session's very first row,
  -- announcing the mode that was already active before the user's first
  -- prompt was even sent - reads wrong appearing underneath that prompt)
  -- and for the mid-session mode-SWITCH case (fires on the row of the NEW
  -- prompt after a switch was detected - the switch governs that prompt,
  -- so it reads better landing right before it too).
  --
  -- tie=1.5 (a genuinely new, non-integer tie value - not one of the
  -- existing dense 0/1/2/3/4 buckets reused) was chosen over the more
  -- obvious-looking tie=0 specifically because of the "starting mode" case:
  -- that row's sort_ts/ts are the session's very first timestamp, the SAME
  -- value session_header (tie=0) and session_stats (tie=1) key off of
  -- (sh.first_ts). Reusing tie=0 or tie=1 there would make this marker's
  -- sort key EXACTLY equal to header's or stats' own key on every field
  -- (sort_ts, tie, ts all tied) - arraySort has no documented stability
  -- guarantee for genuinely tied keys, and unlike the header row (an empty
  -- line, so any ambiguity there is invisible), session_stats is a large,
  -- visually significant multi-line block: an arbitrary tie-break landing
  -- this one-line marker in the middle of - or above - that block would be
  -- a real, visible regression, not a cosmetic no-op. tie=1.5 sits strictly
  -- between session_stats (1) and the prompt marker (2) with no tiebreak
  -- ever required against either: 1 < 1.5 < 2 always decides the order
  -- outright, for both the "starting mode" case (lands directly below the
  -- stats block, still above the first prompt) and the mid-session switch
  -- case (lands directly above the prompt it now governs, same as before).
  -- This does NOT break the "tie is used as a dense small integer range"
  -- assumption elsewhere: nothing in this query relies on tie values being
  -- contiguous/dense - arraySort's tuple comparison works over any orderable
  -- type - and the UNION ALL branches all still resolve to one common
  -- numeric supertype (Float64) the same way an INT/INT UNION would resolve
  -- to a wider INT type, verified against real data before deploying.
  -- Additive: this row's own prompt/tool-call/reply line (tie=2/tie=3)
  -- still renders separately; same ts/sort_ts as that row so this line
  -- sorts immediately adjacent to it (now before, not after) rather than
  -- being interleaved elsewhere in the tree. No truncation cap beyond a
  -- generous 120 chars (these are short fixed labels like "Collaboration
  -- Mode: Default" / "Plan Mode (Conversational)", never free-form text).
  SELECT sr.session_id, sr.timestamp AS ts, if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', coalesce(ca.anchor_ts, sr.timestamp), sr.timestamp) AS sort_ts, 1.5 AS tie,
    concat(
      '<a href="/d/${__dashboard.uid}/agents-overview?var-session_id=', encodeURLComponent(sr.session_id), '&var-trace_ts=', encodeURLComponent(sr.litellm_call_id), '&dtab=Sessions-%26-Debugging&Sessions-%26-Debugging-dtab=Trace" style="opacity:0">', formatDateTime(toTimeZone(sr.timestamp, '${__timezone}'), '%H:%i:%S'), '</a>', '  ',
      if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', '   ', ''),
      '○ ',
      '<span style="opacity:.6">',
      replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(
        substringUTF8(JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'collaboration_mode_change'), 1, 120),
        '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'),
      '</span>'
    ) AS line
  FROM scoped_events sr
  INNER JOIN first_real fr ON fr.session_id = sr.session_id
  LEFT JOIN child_anchor ca ON ca.session_id = sr.session_id AND ca.agent_id = sr.agent_invocation_id
  WHERE sr.timestamp >= fr.ts AND JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'collaboration_mode_change') != ''

  UNION ALL

  -- AskUserQuestion array elements rendered as nested grey lines - the sole
  -- display of this tool's args (tie=3's own tool-call row shows none, see
  -- tool_render above), one per questions[] entry read directly off this
  -- row's own calculated_payload (calculated_type = 'ask_user_question'),
  -- replacing the old join into tool_args_json (no longer needed - the
  -- questions array already lives on the same row being rendered).
  SELECT sr.session_id, sr.timestamp AS ts, if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', coalesce(ca.anchor_ts, sr.timestamp), sr.timestamp) AS sort_ts, 4 AS tie,
    concat(
      '<a href="/d/${__dashboard.uid}/agents-overview?var-session_id=', encodeURLComponent(sr.session_id), '&var-trace_ts=', encodeURLComponent(sr.litellm_call_id), '&dtab=Sessions-%26-Debugging&Sessions-%26-Debugging-dtab=Trace" style="opacity:0">', formatDateTime(toTimeZone(sr.timestamp, '${__timezone}'), '%H:%i:%S'), '</a>', '  ',
      if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', '   ', ''),
      '○ ',  -- Use hollow circle for questions (read-only info)
      '<span style="opacity:.6">',
      replaceRegexpAll(
        substringUTF8(replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceAll(question, '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), 1, 120),
        '\n', '<br>          '),
      if(lengthUTF8(question) > 120, '...', ''),
      '</span>'
    ) AS line
  FROM scoped_events sr
  INNER JOIN first_real fr ON fr.session_id = sr.session_id
  LEFT JOIN child_anchor ca ON ca.session_id = sr.session_id AND ca.agent_id = sr.agent_invocation_id
  ARRAY JOIN arrayMap(x -> JSONExtractString(x, 'question'), JSONExtractArrayRaw(sr.calculated_payload, 'questions')) AS question
  WHERE sr.timestamp >= fr.ts
    AND sr.calculated_type = 'ask_user_question'
    AND sr.status != 'failure'
) AS display_rows
GROUP BY session_id
ORDER BY session_id
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_76'

spec.title: Tool calls at $trace_ts
spec.description: Detail table for a single moment in the Trace panel above - click a timestamp link there (which carries that row's litellm_call_id) to list every tool call made by that exact agent_events row or, if the clicked row is an Agent spawn (▸ marker), all tool calls from the spawned child agent and one level of its own sub-agents (arbitrary nesting depth support (handles ingestion race where agent_invocation_id is blank on later rows)). Key = tool name, value = full arguments - use the magnifier/inspect icon on Arguments to see it in full. A single model call can invoke more than one tool in parallel, which the Trace tree above only shows the first of - this table shows all of them. Empty until a timestamp has been clicked ($trace_ts starts blank).

spec.rawSql:
WITH clicked_row AS (
  SELECT timestamp, tool_name, agent_invocation_id, session_id, litellm_call_id,
    calculated_type, calculated_payload, status, failed_tool_name, failed_tool_error
  FROM agent_events
  WHERE '$trace_ts' != ''
    AND litellm_call_id = '$trace_ts'
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
),
agent_spawn_events AS (
  SELECT session_id, timestamp
  FROM agent_events
  WHERE calculated_type = 'agent_spawn' AND agent_invocation_id = ''
    AND agent_events.session_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT session_id FROM clicked_row)
),
clicked_event_info AS (
  SELECT
    cr.timestamp AS event_ts,
    cr.tool_name,
    cr.agent_invocation_id,
    cr.session_id,
    cr.status,
    cr.failed_tool_name,
    cr.failed_tool_error,
    if(cr.calculated_type = 'agent_spawn' AND cr.agent_invocation_id = '', 'spawn', 'non_spawn') AS click_type
  FROM clicked_row cr
),
-- For spawn clicks, find the next spawn's timestamp (if any) to bound the collection window
next_spawn_ts AS (
  SELECT
    cei.event_ts,
    argMinIf(ase.timestamp, ase.timestamp, ase.timestamp > cei.event_ts) AS next_spawn
  FROM clicked_event_info cei
  CROSS JOIN agent_spawn_events ase
  WHERE cei.click_type = 'spawn'
  GROUP BY cei.event_ts
),
-- Every calculated_type shape known to _classify_event is normalized here into a
-- single array of {"tool":...,"args":...} JSON objects, so both the direct and
-- descendant branches below can walk one uniform shape via a single
-- JSONExtractArrayRaw + arrayJoin, rather than re-deriving the OpenAI-style
-- tool_calls[].function.{name,arguments} shape from raw_payload as before.
-- 'tool_call' rows already carry the full parallel-call array under 'tools'
-- (built at ingest from every entry in that model turn's own tool_calls array -
-- see _classify_event) - skill_call/ask_user_question/agent_spawn rows only
-- describe themselves, so they're each wrapped into a synthetic one-element array
-- to keep the same downstream shape.
direct_tool_calls AS (
  SELECT JSONExtractString(t, 'tool') AS Tool,
         JSONExtractRaw(t, 'args') AS Arguments,
         ts AS Ts
  FROM (
    SELECT arrayJoin(
      multiIf(
        cr.calculated_type = 'tool_call', JSONExtractArrayRaw(cr.calculated_payload, 'tools'),
        cr.calculated_type = 'skill_call', [concat('{"tool":"Skill","args":', JSONExtractRaw(cr.calculated_payload, 'args'), '}')],
        cr.calculated_type = 'ask_user_question', [concat('{"tool":"AskUserQuestion","args":{"questions":', JSONExtractRaw(cr.calculated_payload, 'questions'), '}}')],
        cr.calculated_type = 'agent_spawn', [concat('{"tool":"Agent","args":', cr.calculated_payload, '}')],
        []
      )
    ) AS t, cr.timestamp AS ts
    FROM clicked_row cr
    CROSS JOIN clicked_event_info cei
    WHERE cei.click_type = 'non_spawn'
  ) x
),
-- Child and descendant tool calls: all events within spawn's execution window.
-- Timestamp-based matching (not strict agent_invocation_id equality) handles the
-- ingestion race where agent_invocation_id lands blank on some descendant rows,
-- and naturally covers arbitrary nesting depth (grandchildren, etc.) within the
-- same window.
child_and_descendant_tool_calls AS (
  SELECT JSONExtractString(t, 'tool') AS Tool,
         JSONExtractRaw(t, 'args') AS Arguments,
         ts AS Ts
  FROM (
    SELECT arrayJoin(
      multiIf(
        ae.calculated_type = 'tool_call', JSONExtractArrayRaw(ae.calculated_payload, 'tools'),
        ae.calculated_type = 'skill_call', [concat('{"tool":"Skill","args":', JSONExtractRaw(ae.calculated_payload, 'args'), '}')],
        ae.calculated_type = 'ask_user_question', [concat('{"tool":"AskUserQuestion","args":{"questions":', JSONExtractRaw(ae.calculated_payload, 'questions'), '}}')],
        ae.calculated_type = 'agent_spawn', [concat('{"tool":"Agent","args":', ae.calculated_payload, '}')],
        []
      )
    ) AS t,
    ae.timestamp AS ts
    FROM clicked_event_info cei
    LEFT JOIN next_spawn_ts nst ON nst.event_ts = cei.event_ts
    INNER JOIN agent_events ae ON ae.session_id = cei.session_id
    WHERE cei.click_type = 'spawn'
      AND ae.timestamp > cei.event_ts  -- After the spawn
      AND ae.timestamp != cei.event_ts  -- Not the spawn row itself
      -- Before next spawn (if exists; default DateTime64 is 1970-01-01)
      AND (nst.next_spawn = '1970-01-01T00:00:00'::DateTime64(6) OR ae.timestamp < nst.next_spawn)
  )
),
-- Error handling: surface failure rows separately. failed_tool_name/
-- failed_tool_error are their own columns (unaffected by raw_payload's removal),
-- so this branch is unchanged from before the schema migration.
error_rows AS (
  SELECT
    if(cei.failed_tool_name != '', cei.failed_tool_name, 'LLM_Error') AS Tool,
    cei.failed_tool_error AS Arguments,
    cei.event_ts AS Ts
  FROM clicked_event_info cei
  WHERE cei.status = 'failure' OR cei.failed_tool_name != ''
)
SELECT Tool, Arguments, Ts FROM direct_tool_calls
UNION ALL
SELECT Tool, Arguments, Ts FROM child_and_descendant_tool_calls
UNION ALL
SELECT Tool, Arguments, Ts FROM error_rows
ORDER BY Ts

spec.title: Issue overview
spec.description:
Goal: See cost/tokens/cache-hit/sessions/users per tracked issue in one place.
Description: Groups agent_usage by issue_id parsed from the branch name via session_git_branch_dict; untagged sessions group under "empty".

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty') AS issue_id,
  count(DISTINCT u.session_id) AS sessions,
  count(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS users,
  sum(u.cost) AS cost,
  sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens))) AS tokens_input,
  sum(u.output_tokens) AS tokens_output,
  avg(u.cache_hit) AS cache_hit,
  min(u.timestamp) AS first_seen,
  max(u.timestamp) AS last_seen
FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
GROUP BY issue_id
ORDER BY cost DESC

spec.title: Call graph for selected session(s)
spec.description:
Goal: Visualize the full sequence of prompts/responses/tool calls for a specific session as a graph, for deep debugging.
Description: One query builds nodes - prompts filtered to "real" ones via the same prompt_kind classification the Trace panel uses, and actions for tool/skill/agent-spawn/answer events; a second builds edges from per-invocation call sequence plus a best-effort ASOF join linking subagent invocations back to their spawning call. Prompts render red, responses yellow, tool/skill/agent-spawn/question actions grey, everything else (judge calls, title gen, system notifications, transcript handoffs) green - click a node to see its full text/payload.

spec.rawSql:
WITH selected AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session_id FROM agent_events
  WHERE (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], session_id))
),
scoped AS (
  SELECT
    ev.session_id AS session_id, ev.timestamp AS ts, ev.litellm_call_id AS call_id,
    ev.agent_invocation_id AS agent_invocation_id, ev.tool_name AS tool_name,
    ev.status AS status, ev.calculated_type AS calculated_type, ev.calculated_payload AS calculated_payload,
    m.prompt_text AS prompt_text, m.response_text AS response_text,
    min(ev.timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY ev.session_id, ev.agent_invocation_id, m.prompt_text) AS first_prompt_ts
  FROM agent_events ev
  INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = ev.session_id
  LEFT JOIN agent_messages m ON m.session_id = ev.session_id
    AND ev.litellm_call_id != '' AND m.litellm_call_id = ev.litellm_call_id
),
prompt_calc AS (
  SELECT *,
    JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'prompt_kind') AS prompt_kind,
    JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'display_text') AS display_text,
    (JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'prompt_kind') = 'command'
      AND (position(prompt_text, '<transcript>') > 0
        OR position(prompt_text, 'This session is being continued from') > 0)
    ) AS is_command_echo
  FROM scoped
  WHERE prompt_text != '' AND ts = first_prompt_ts
),
-- Real, user-authored prompts only (mirrors the "Trace" panel's own is_real
-- classification: prompt_kind is computed once at ingest by
-- _prompt_kind_and_display in services/_common/src/ingest_parsing.py and stored in
-- calculated_payload - harness noise like judge_call/title_gen/
-- suggestion_mode/transcript_handoff/system_notification/stop_hook_feedback/
-- webpage_content, and a "command"-kind row that's actually a resent
-- transcript/compaction-summary echoing an old <command-args> tag, render as
-- their own action node in `system` color instead, not as a red prompt node).
prompt_nodes AS (
  SELECT concat('p_', call_id) AS id,
    substring(replaceRegexpAll(coalesce(nullIf(display_text, ''), prompt_text), '\s+', ' '), 1, 40) AS title,
    'prompt' AS subTitle,
    toString(ts) AS mainStat,
    toFloat64(1) AS arc__prompt, toFloat64(0) AS arc__response, toFloat64(0) AS arc__system, toFloat64(0) AS arc__tool,
    substring(prompt_text, 1, 4000) AS detail__full_text,
    prompt_kind AS detail__meta
  FROM prompt_calc
  WHERE (NOT (prompt_kind IN ('system_notification', 'suggestion_mode', 'judge_call', 'title_gen', 'transcript_handoff', 'stop_hook_feedback', 'webpage_content'))
    AND NOT is_command_echo)
),
action_nodes AS (
  SELECT concat('a_', call_id) AS id,
    multiIf(
      calculated_type = 'tool_call', tool_name,
      calculated_type = 'skill_call', JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'skill'),
      calculated_type = 'agent_spawn', concat('Agent: ', JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'subagent_type')),
      calculated_type = 'ask_user_question', 'AskUserQuestion',
      calculated_type = 'llm_answer', substring(replaceRegexpAll(response_text, '\s+', ' '), 1, 40),
      calculated_type
    ) AS title,
    calculated_type AS subTitle,
    toString(ts) AS mainStat,
    toFloat64(0) AS arc__prompt,
    toFloat64(calculated_type = 'llm_answer') AS arc__response,
    toFloat64(calculated_type NOT IN ('llm_answer', 'tool_call', 'skill_call', 'agent_spawn', 'ask_user_question')) AS arc__system,
    toFloat64(calculated_type IN ('tool_call', 'skill_call', 'agent_spawn', 'ask_user_question')) AS arc__tool,
    substring(if(calculated_type = 'llm_answer', response_text, calculated_payload), 1, 4000) AS detail__full_text,
    status AS detail__meta
  FROM scoped
)
SELECT id, title, subTitle, mainStat, arc__prompt, arc__response, arc__system, arc__tool, detail__full_text, detail__meta FROM prompt_nodes
UNION ALL
SELECT id, title, subTitle, mainStat, arc__prompt, arc__response, arc__system, arc__tool, detail__full_text, detail__meta FROM action_nodes

SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_86'

WITH selected AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session_id FROM agent_events
  WHERE (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], session_id))
),
scoped AS (
  SELECT
    ev.session_id AS session_id, ev.timestamp AS ts, ev.litellm_call_id AS call_id,
    ev.agent_invocation_id AS agent_invocation_id,
    ev.calculated_payload AS calculated_payload,
    m.prompt_text AS prompt_text,
    min(ev.timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY ev.session_id, ev.agent_invocation_id, m.prompt_text) AS first_prompt_ts
  FROM agent_events ev
  INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = ev.session_id
  LEFT JOIN agent_messages m ON m.session_id = ev.session_id
    AND ev.litellm_call_id != '' AND m.litellm_call_id = ev.litellm_call_id
),
prompt_calc AS (
  SELECT *,
    JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'prompt_kind') AS prompt_kind,
    (JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'prompt_kind') = 'command'
      AND (position(prompt_text, '<transcript>') > 0
        OR position(prompt_text, 'This session is being continued from') > 0)
    ) AS is_command_echo
  FROM scoped
),
-- Same is_real gate as prompt_nodes above - a harness-noise prompt never got
-- its own p_<id> node there, so entry_id must fall back to a_<id> here too
-- or an edge would point at a node id absent from the nodes query's result.
primary_node AS (
  SELECT session_id, ts, call_id, agent_invocation_id,
    if(prompt_text != '' AND ts = first_prompt_ts
        AND (NOT (prompt_kind IN ('system_notification', 'suggestion_mode', 'judge_call', 'title_gen', 'transcript_handoff', 'stop_hook_feedback', 'webpage_content'))
          AND NOT is_command_echo),
      concat('p_', call_id), concat('a_', call_id)) AS entry_id,
    concat('a_', call_id) AS action_id
  FROM prompt_calc
),
seq AS (
  SELECT session_id, agent_invocation_id, ts, call_id, entry_id, action_id,
    lagInFrame(action_id) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, agent_invocation_id ORDER BY ts) AS prev_action_id
  FROM primary_node
)
SELECT concat('e_pa_', call_id) AS id, entry_id AS source, action_id AS target
FROM seq WHERE entry_id != action_id
UNION ALL
SELECT concat('e_seq_', call_id) AS id, prev_action_id AS source, entry_id AS target
FROM seq WHERE prev_action_id != ''
UNION ALL
-- Best-effort heuristic, not a real FK: the nearest-preceding orchestrator-
-- level agent_spawn event before this subagent invocation started. See
-- panel-76's own identical ASOF-join comment for why no exact link exists.
SELECT concat('e_spawn_', ca.agent_id) AS id, concat('a_', ca.parent_call_id) AS source, cf.entry_id AS target
FROM (
  SELECT agent_invocation_id, argMin(entry_id, ts) AS entry_id
  FROM primary_node WHERE agent_invocation_id != '' GROUP BY agent_invocation_id
) cf
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT ai.agent_id AS agent_id, any(se.call_id) AS parent_call_id
  FROM agent_invocations ai
  INNER JOIN selected s ON s.session_id = ai.session_id
  ASOF LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT session_id, timestamp, litellm_call_id AS call_id
    FROM agent_events WHERE calculated_type = 'agent_spawn' AND agent_invocation_id = ''
  ) se ON se.session_id = ai.session_id AND ai.spawned_at >= se.timestamp
  GROUP BY ai.agent_id
) ca ON ca.agent_id = cf.agent_invocation_id
WHERE ca.parent_call_id != ''

SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_86'

spec.title: /plan invocations over time
spec.description:
Goal: Track how much /plan usage volume is happening over time.
Description: Counts agent_events rows with command_name='plan' OR a Plan-Mode-change payload marker, per time bucket; one /plan invocation spans many calls, so this tracks call volume, not invocation count - see the table below for one row per invocation.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  count() AS value
FROM agent_events
WHERE (command_name = 'plan' OR JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'collaboration_mode_change') LIKE 'Plan Mode%')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_87'

spec.title: /plan usage log
spec.description:
Goal: See the detail behind each individual /plan invocation.
Description: One row per session, joining per-session call count/duration from agent_events to input/output token and cost totals from agent_usage and the first real prompt text (preferring an explicit /plan argument, falling back to the session's first real prompt). Click the value in 'arguments' to see the full text.

spec.rawSql:
WITH goal_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    agent_events.session_id AS session_id,
    min(timestamp) AS started_at,
    max(timestamp) AS last_call_at,
    count() AS calls,
    any(agent_events.user_id) AS session_user_id,
    any(dictGetOrDefault('ai_gateway_users_dict', 'user_name', agent_events.user_id, '')) AS session_user_name
  FROM agent_events
  WHERE (command_name = 'plan' OR JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'collaboration_mode_change') LIKE 'Plan Mode%')
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], agent_events.user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
    AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  GROUP BY agent_events.session_id
),
prompts AS (
  SELECT session_id,
    coalesce(
      nullIf(argMinIf(replaceRegexpOne(JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'display_text'), '^/plan ', ''), timestamp, command_name = 'plan' AND JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'display_text') != ''), ''),
      argMinIf(JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'display_text'), timestamp, JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'prompt_kind') = 'real' AND JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'display_text') != '')
    ) AS prompt_text
  FROM agent_events
  WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM goal_sessions)
  GROUP BY session_id
),
usage AS (
  SELECT session_id, sum((input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (cache_creation_tokens + cache_read_tokens))) AS tokens_input, sum(output_tokens) AS tokens_output, sum(cost) AS cost
  FROM agent_usage
  GROUP BY session_id
)
SELECT
  gs.started_at AS timestamp,
  gs.session_user_id AS user_id,
  gs.session_id AS session_id,
  gs.session_user_name AS user_name,
  gs.calls AS "llm calls",
  round(dateDiff('second', gs.started_at, gs.last_call_at) / 60.0, 2) AS "duration (min)",
  coalesce(u.tokens_input, 0) AS tokens_input,
  coalesce(u.tokens_output, 0) AS tokens_output,
  coalesce(u.cost, 0) AS cost,
  p.prompt_text AS "arguments"
FROM goal_sessions gs
LEFT JOIN prompts p ON p.session_id = gs.session_id
LEFT JOIN usage u ON u.session_id = gs.session_id
ORDER BY gs.started_at DESC
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_88'

spec.title: Clients
spec.description:
Goal: See which calling client (CLI/version) is producing events.
Description: Groups agent_events by event_client_id, resolves the display string via the append-only clients dictionary (argMax by updated_at), with distinct-session counts and first/last-seen per exact client string, sorted by name.

spec.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    agent_events.event_client_id AS event_client_id,
    count(distinct session_id) AS sessions,
    min(timestamp) AS first_seen,
    max(timestamp) AS last_seen
  FROM agent_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND event_client_id != 0
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
    AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
    AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
      SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
      WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
        AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
    ))
    AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
    AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
    AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
  GROUP BY event_client_id
)
SELECT
  c.value AS name,
  f.sessions AS sessions,
  f.first_seen AS first_seen,
  f.last_seen AS last_seen
FROM filtered f
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT id, argMax(value, updated_at) AS value
  FROM clients
  GROUP BY id
) c ON c.id = f.event_client_id
ORDER BY name ASC
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_91'

spec.title: Clients (share)
spec.description:
Goal: See the relative share of events by client family, rather than one row per exact version.
Description: Same event_client_id grouping as 'Clients', but strips the version suffix (everything after the first space) before re-aggregating session counts.

spec.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    agent_events.event_client_id AS event_client_id,
    count(distinct session_id) AS sessions,
    min(timestamp) AS first_seen,
    max(timestamp) AS last_seen
  FROM agent_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND event_client_id != 0
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
    AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
    AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
      SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
      WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
        AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
    ))
    AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
    AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
    AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
  GROUP BY event_client_id
)
SELECT
  if(position(c.value, ' ') > 0, substring(c.value, 1, position(c.value, ' ') - 1), c.value) AS name,
  sum(f.sessions) AS sessions
FROM filtered f
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT id, argMax(value, updated_at) AS value
  FROM clients
  GROUP BY id
) c ON c.id = f.event_client_id
GROUP BY name
ORDER BY name ASC
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_92'

spec.name: window
spec.label: Window
spec.description: Controls how timeseries data is grouped/aggregated over time (e.g. 1m = per minute); does not affect the selected time range.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT git_repo AS __value, git_repo AS __text FROM session_git_branch WHERE git_repo != ''
ORDER BY __value

SELECT DISTINCT git_branch AS __value, git_branch AS __text FROM session_git_branch WHERE git_branch != ''
ORDER BY __value
SELECT coalesce(nullIf(issue_id, ''), 'empty') AS __value FROM session_git_branch GROUP BY __value ORDER BY __value = 'empty' DESC, __value

spec.name: provider
spec.label: Provider
spec.description: Filters the Model list below. Claude = claude-*, OpenAI = gpt-*/o-series/etc., Other = everything else.
spec.query: All : all, Claude : claude, OpenAI : openai, Other : other

spec.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT model AS __value, model AS __text
  FROM agent_usage
  WHERE model != ''
    AND (
      '$provider' = 'all'
      OR ('$provider' = 'claude' AND match(model, '^claude-'))
      OR ('$provider' = 'openai' AND match(model, '^(gpt-|chatgpt-|o[0-9]|text-embedding-|dall-e-|whisper|tts-)'))
      OR ('$provider' = 'other' AND NOT match(model, '^(claude-|gpt-|chatgpt-|o[0-9]|text-embedding-|dall-e-|whisper|tts-)'))
    )
)
SELECT __value, __text FROM (
  SELECT __value, __text FROM filtered
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '__none__' AS __value, '(no models for this provider yet)' AS __text WHERE (SELECT count() FROM filtered) = 0
) ORDER BY __value

SELECT DISTINCT agent_name AS __value, agent_name AS __text FROM agent_events WHERE agent_name != ''
ORDER BY __value

SELECT DISTINCT skill_name AS __value, skill_name AS __text FROM agent_events WHERE skill_name != ''
ORDER BY __value

SELECT DISTINCT command_name AS __value, command_name AS __text FROM agent_events WHERE command_name != ''
ORDER BY __value

SELECT DISTINCT
  tool_name AS __value,
  replaceOne(tool_name, 'mcp__', '') AS __text
FROM agent_events
WHERE startsWith(tool_name, 'mcp__')
ORDER BY __value

spec.name: group_id
spec.label: Group
spec.description: LiteLLM Team a virtual key belongs to, keyed on the stable user_api_key_team_id (not the renamable team alias - see services/_common/src/ingest_parsing.py:_group_id/_group_alias) - empty for every user until LiteLLM Teams are configured (README "LiteLLM" – "Once it's needed: Teams..."), which is an operator action outside this dashboard.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  g.group_id AS __value,
  coalesce(any(grp.group_name), g.group_id) AS __text
FROM agent_events g
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT group_id, argMax(group_name, updated_at) AS group_name
  FROM ai_gateway_groups
  GROUP BY group_id
) grp ON grp.group_id = g.group_id
WHERE g.group_id != ''
GROUP BY g.group_id
ORDER BY __text

SELECT
  e.user_id AS __value,
  coalesce(any(usr.user_name), e.user_id) AS __text
FROM agent_events e
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT user_id, argMax(user_name, updated_at) AS user_name
  FROM ai_gateway_users
  GROUP BY user_id
) usr ON usr.user_id = e.user_id
WHERE e.user_id NOT IN ('', 'unknown-user')
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], e.group_id))
GROUP BY e.user_id
ORDER BY __value

spec.name: session_id
spec.label: Session

spec.rawSql:
SELECT __value, __text FROM (
  SELECT '' AS __value, 'All' AS __text, toDateTime64('2100-01-01', 3) AS __ts
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    e.session_id AS __value,
    concat(formatDateTime(max(e.timestamp), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S'), ' - ', e.session_id, ' - ', coalesce(any(usr.user_name), any(e.user_id))) AS __text,
    max(e.timestamp) AS __ts
  FROM agent_events e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT user_id, argMax(user_name, updated_at) AS user_name
    FROM ai_gateway_users
    GROUP BY user_id
  ) usr ON usr.user_id = e.user_id
  WHERE e.session_id != ''
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], e.user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], e.group_id))
    -- exclude sessions with no real user-facing prompt (agent_messages.prompt_text always empty)
    AND e.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM agent_messages WHERE prompt_text != '')
    -- exclude plan-mode sub-sessions: forked contexts where every turn is command_name='plan' (see agent_docs/incidents.md)
    AND e.session_id NOT IN (
      SELECT session_id FROM agent_messages GROUP BY session_id HAVING sum(command_name != 'plan') = 0
    )
  GROUP BY e.session_id
  ORDER BY __ts DESC
  LIMIT 200
)
ORDER BY __ts DESC

spec.description: Value format: <timestamp> - <session_id> - <user_id>

spec.name: trace_ts
spec.label: Trace timestamp
spec.description: Hidden - set by clicking a timestamp link in the Trace panel; the trace-detail table below it reads this to show every tool call made at that exact moment.

spec.name: trace_width_budget
spec.label: Trace width budget
spec.description: Hidden - single source of truth for the Trace panel's (panel-76) total-line character-width budget used to align tool-call/agent-spawn stats columns (duration/tokens/cost). Referenced unquoted (bare number, no :singlequote) as ${trace_width_budget} inside panel-76's rawSql, including in arithmetic like (${trace_width_budget} - 3) for the nested-row indent deduction. Edit this variable's value to retune the width instead of hunting for scattered literals in rawSql.

spec.name: include_cache_tokens
spec.label: Include cache tokens
spec.description: Controls whether every 'tokens'/'input tokens' panel on this dashboard includes prompt-cache tokens. LiteLLM folds cache_creation_tokens and cache_read_tokens into input_tokens by default for cache-capable providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, and others), so headline token totals are cache-inclusive unless this is switched off. On (default) = today's numbers, unchanged. Off = input_tokens minus cache_creation_tokens and cache_read_tokens, i.e. net/fresh input tokens only. Output tokens are never affected by this toggle.
